  "content": "//\n//  VCard.swift\n//  ContactManager\n//\n//  Pure vCard 3.0 reading and writing. Kept free of SwiftData/UI types so it\n//  is straightforward to unit test; the import/export views map between these\n//  values and `Contact` models.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\n\n/// A contact decoded from a vCard, independent of SwiftData.\nstruct ParsedContact: Equatable {\n    var firstName = \"\"\n    var lastName = \"\"\n    var company = \"\"\n    var jobTitle = \"\"\n    var notes = \"\"\n    var birthday: Date?\n    var street = \"\"\n    var city = \"\"\n    var state = \"\"\n    var postalCode = \"\"\n    var country = \"\"\n    var emails: [(label: FieldLabel, value: String)] = []\n    var phones: [(label: FieldLabel, value: String)] = []\n\n    static func == (lhs: ParsedContact, rhs: ParsedContact) -> Bool {\n        lhs.firstName == rhs.firstName && lhs.lastName == rhs.lastName\n            && lhs.company == rhs.company && lhs.jobTitle == rhs.jobTitle\n            && lhs.notes == rhs.notes && lhs.birthday == rhs.birthday\n            && lhs.street == rhs.street && lhs.city == rhs.city\n            && lhs.state == rhs.state && lhs.postalCode == rhs.postalCode\n            && lhs.country == rhs.country\n            && lhs.emails.map(\\.value) == rhs.emails.map(\\.value)\n            && lhs.emails.map(\\.label) == rhs.emails.map(\\.label)\n            && lhs.phones.map(\\.value) == rhs.phones.map(\\.value)\n            && lhs.phones.map(\\.label) == rhs.phones.map(\\.label)\n    }\n}\n\nenum VCard {\n    private static let lineEnding = \"\\r\\n\"\n\n    private static let birthdayFormatter: DateFormatter = {\n        let formatter = DateFormatter()\n        formatter.locale = Locale(identifier: \"en_US_POSIX\")\n        formatter.dateFormat = \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n        formatter.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: \"UTC\")\n        return formatter\n    }()\n\n    // MARK: - Writing\n\n    /// Serializes contacts into a single vCard document.\n    static func makeDocument(from contacts: [Contact]) -> String {\n        contacts.map(card(for:)).joined()\n    }\n\n    static func card(for contact: Contact) -> String {\n        var lines = [\"BEGIN:VCARD\", \"VERSION:3.0\"]\n\n        let last = escape(contact.lastName)\n        let first = escape(contact.firstName)\n        lines.append(\"N:\\(last);\\(first);;;\")\n        lines.append(\"FN:\\(escape(contact.fullName))\")\n\n        if !contact.company.isEmpty { lines.append(\"ORG:\\(escape(contact.company))\") }\n        if !contact.jobTitle.isEmpty { lines.append(\"TITLE:\\(escape(contact.jobTitle))\") }\n\n        for email in contact.emails where !email.value.isEmpty {\n            lines.append(\"EMAIL;TYPE=\\(typeName(email.label)):\\(escape(email.value))\")\n        }\n        for phone in contact.phones where !phone.value.isEmpty {\n            lines.append(\"TEL;TYPE=\\(typeName(phone.label)):\\(escape(phone.value))\")\n        }\n\n        if hasAddress(contact) {\n            let parts = [contact.street, contact.city, contact.state, contact.postalCode, contact.country]\n                .map(escape)\n            lines.append(\"ADR;TYPE=HOME:;;\\(parts.joined(separator: \";\"))\")\n        }\n\n        if let birthday = contact.birthday {\n            lines.append(\"BDAY:\\(birthdayFormatter.string(from: birthday))\")\n        }\n        if !contact.notes.isEmpty {\n            lines.append(\"NOTE:\\(escape(contact.notes))\")\n        }\n\n        lines.append(\"END:VCARD\")\n        return lines.joined(separator: lineEnding) + lineEnding\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Reading\n\n    /// Parses one or more vCards from a document.\n    static func parse(_ text: String) -> [ParsedContact] {\n        var results: [ParsedContact] = []\n        var current: ParsedContact?\n\n        for line in unfold(text) {\n            let upper = line.uppercased()\n            if upper == \"BEGIN:VCARD\" {\n                current = ParsedContact()\n            } else if upper == \"END:VCARD\" {\n                if let card = current { results.append(card) }\n                current = nil\n            } else if current != nil {\n                apply(line: line, to: &current!)\n            }\n        }\n        return results\n    }\n\n    private static func apply(line: String, to card: inout ParsedContact) {\n        guard let colon = line.firstIndex(of: \":\") else { return }\n        let descriptor = String(line[line.startIndex..<colon])\n        let value = String(line[line.index(after: colon)...])\n\n        let segments = descriptor.uppercased().split(separator: \";\").map(String.init)\n        guard let property = segments.first else { return }\n        let params = Array(segments.dropFirst())\n\n        switch property {\n        case \"N\":\n            let comps = splitStructured(value)\n            card.lastName = comps.count > 0 ? comps[0] : \"\"\n            card.firstName = comps.count > 1 ? comps[1] : \"\"\n        case \"FN\":\n            // Only use FN for names if N didn't provide them.\n            if card.firstName.isEmpty && card.lastName.isEmpty {\n                let unescaped = unescape(value)\n                let pieces = unescaped.split(separator: \" \", maxSplits: 1).map(String.init)\n                card.firstName = pieces.first ?? unescaped\n                card.lastName = pieces.count > 1 ? pieces[1] : \"\"\n            }\n        case \"ORG\":\n            card.company = splitStructured(value).first ?? unescape(value)\n        case \"TITLE\":\n            card.jobTitle = unescape(value)\n        case \"EMAIL\":\n            card.emails.append((label(from: params), unescape(value)))\n        case \"TEL\":\n            card.phones.append((label(from: params), unescape(value)))\n        case \"ADR\":\n            let comps = splitStructured(value)\n            // ADR: pobox;ext;street;city;state;postal;country\n            card.street = comps.count > 2 ? comps[2] : \"\"\n            card.city = comps.count > 3 ? comps[3] : \"\"\n            card.state = comps.count > 4 ? comps[4] : \"\"\n            card.postalCode = comps.count > 5 ? comps[5] : \"\"\n            card.country = comps.count > 6 ? comps[6] : \"\"\n        case \"BDAY\":\n            card.birthday = birthdayFormatter.date(from: String(value.prefix(10)))\n        case \"NOTE\":\n            card.notes = unescape(value)\n        default:\n            break\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Label mapping\n\n    private static func typeName(_ label: FieldLabel) -> String {\n        switch label {\n        case .home: return \"HOME\"\n        case .work: return \"WORK\"\n        case .mobile: return \"CELL\"\n        case .main: return \"MAIN\"\n        case .other: return \"OTHER\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static func label(from params: [String]) -> FieldLabel {\n        let types = params\n            .flatMap { $0.replacingOccurrences(of: \"TYPE=\", with: \"\").split(separator: \",\") }\n            .map { String($0).uppercased() }\n        if types.contains(\"CELL\") || types.contains(\"MOBILE\") { return .mobile }\n        if types.contains(\"WORK\") { return .work }\n        if types.contains(\"HOME\") { return .home }\n        if types.contains(\"MAIN\") { return .main }\n        return .other\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Escaping & folding\n\n    private static func escape(_ value: String) -> String {\n        value\n            .replacingOccurrences(of: \"\\\\\", with: \"\\\\\\\\\")\n            .replacingOccurrences(of: \"\\n\", with: \"\\\\n\")\n            .replacingOccurrences(of: \",\", with: \"\\\\,\")\n            .replacingOccurrences(of: \";\", with: \"\\\\;\")\n    }\n\n    private static func unescape(_ value: String) -> String {\n        var result = \"\"\n        var iterator = value.makeIterator()\n        while let char = iterator.next() {\n            if char == \"\\\\\", let next = iterator.next() {\n                switch next {\n                case \"n\", \"N\": result.append(\"\\n\")\n                default: result.append(next)\n                }\n            } else {\n                result.append(char)\n            }\n        }\n        return result\n    }\n\n    /// Splits a structured value (`;`-separated) honoring escaped separators,\n    /// unescaping each component.\n    private static func splitStructured(_ value: String) -> [String] {\n        var components: [String] = []\n        var current = \"\"\n        var iterator = value.makeIterator()\n        while let char = iterator.next() {\n            if char == \"\\\\\", let next = iterator.next() {\n                if next == \"n\" || next == \"N\" { current.append(\"\\n\") } else { current.append(next) }\n            } else if char == \";\" {\n                components.append(current)\n                current = \"\"\n            } else {\n                current.append(char)\n            }\n        }\n        components.append(current)\n        return components\n    }\n\n    /// Unfolds wrapped lines (continuation lines start with a space or tab).\n    private static func unfold(_ text: String) -> [String] {\n        let rawLines = text.replacingOccurrences(of: \"\\r\\n\", with: \"\\n\").components(separatedBy: \"\\n\")\n        var lines: [String] = []\n        for raw in rawLines {\n            if let first = raw.first, first == \" \" || first == \"\\t\", !lines.isEmpty {\n                lines[lines.count - 1] += raw.dropFirst()\n            } else {\n                lines.append(raw)\n            }\n        }\n        return lines.filter { !$0.isEmpty }\n    }\n\n    private static func hasAddress(_ contact: Contact) -> Bool {\n        ![contact.street, contact.city, contact.state, contact.postalCode, contact.country]\n            .allSatisfy(\\.isEmpty)\n    }\n}\n"
}

                        Button(\"Rename…\") { beginRename(group) }\n                                Button(\"Delete\", role: .destructive) { deleteGroup(group) }\n                            }\n   "content": "//\n//  VCardDocument.swift\n//  ContactManager\n//\n//  A tiny FileDocument wrapping vCard text, used by the export file dialog.\n//\n\nimport SwiftUI\nimport UniformTypeIdentifiers\n\nstruct VCardDocument: FileDocument {\n    static var readableContentTypes: [UTType] { [.vCard] }\n    static var writableContentTypes: [UTType] { [.vCard] }\n\n    var text: String\n\n    init(text: String) {\n        self.text = text\n    }\n\n    init(configuration: ReadConfiguration) throws {\n        let data = configuration.file.regularFileContents ?? Data()\n        text = String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self)\n    }\n\n    func fileWrapper(configuration: WriteConfiguration) throws -> FileWrapper {\n        FileWrapper(regularFileWithContents: Data(text.utf8))\n    }\n}\n"
}

  context.insert(contact)\n        do {\n            try context.save()\n            selectedContact = contact\n        } catch {\n            context.delete(contact)\n            errorMessage = context.delete(contact)\n        do {\n            try context.save()\n            if wasSelected { selectedContact = nil }\n        } catch {\n            context.rollback()\n            errorMessage       do {\n            try context.save()\n            sidebarSelection = .group(group.persistentModelID)\n        } catch {\n            context.delete(group)\n            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func renameGroup(_ group: ContactGroup, to name: String) {\n        let trimmed = name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)\n        guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }\n        group.name = trimmed\n        try? context.save()\n    }\n\n    private func deleteGroup(_ group: ContactGroup) {\n        if case .group(let id) = sidebarSelection, id == group.persistentModelID {\n            sidebarSelection = .allContacts\n        }\n        context.delete(group)\n        try? context.save()\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - vCard .success(let url):\n            let didAccess = url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()\n            defer { if didAccess { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() } }\n\n            guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),\n                  let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else {\n                errorMessage = \"That file couldn't be read as a vCard.\"\n                return\n            }\n\n            let parsed = VCard.parse(text)\n            guard !parsed.isEmpty else {\n                errorMessage = \"No contacts were found in that file.\"\n                return\n            }\n\n            for card in parsed {\n                context.insert(makeContact(from: card))\n            }\n            do { try context.save() } catch { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func makeContact(from parsed: ParsedContact) -> Contact {\n        let contact = Contact(\n            firstName: parsed.firstName, lastName: parsed.lastName,\n            company: parsed.company, jobTitle: parsed.jobTitle,\n            street: parsed.street, city: parsed.city, state: parsed.state,\n            postalCode: parsed.postalCode, country: parsed.country,\n            birthday: parsed.birthday, notes: parsed.notes\n        )\n        var fields: [ContactField] = []\n        for (index, email) in parsed.emails.enumerated() {\n            fields.append(ContactField(kind: .email, label: email.label, value: email.value, sortIndex: index))\n        }\n        for (index, phone) in parsed.phones.enumerated() {\n            fields.append(ContactField(kind: .phone, label: phone.label, value: phone.value, sortIndex: index))\n        }\n        contact.fields = fields\n        return contact\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    ContentView()\n        .modelContainer(for: Contact.self, inMemory: true)\n}\n"

FILE: ContactManager/Views/ContentView.swift:193
BODY: In the vCard import path, contacts are inserted into the ModelContext before saving, but on save failure the code only sets `errorMessage` and leaves the inserted (unsaved) models in the context. This can leave the UI showing contacts that were not persisted and may cause repeated failures on subsequent saves. Track the inserted contacts and either delete them on failure (like `addContact()` does) or call `context.rollback()` in the `catch` to restore a consistent state.

---
FILE: ContactManager/Views/ContentView.swift:193
BODY: `Data(contentsOf:)` and vCard parsing are performed synchronously in the `.fileImporter` completion handler (UI/main thread). Importing a large `.vcf` can block the UI. Consider moving file reading/parsing/insertion into an async `Task` (and, if needed, a detached task for parsing) and only updating UI state / saving on the main actor when ready.

---
FILE: ContactManager/Views/ContentView.swift:165
BODY: `renameGroup` and `deleteGroup` use `try? context.save()`, which silently ignores persistence errors. Since these are explicit user actions (including destructive delete), failures should be surfaced (e.g., set `errorMessage` and rollback) so the sidebar/UI doesn’t diverge from persisted state.

---
FILE: ContactManager/Views/ContentView.swift:36
BODY: `scopedContacts` filters the full `contacts` array in memory by walking each contact’s `groups` relationship. This scales poorly (and can trigger relationship faulting/N+1 behavior) as the store grows. Consider driving the list from the selected `ContactGroup`’s `contacts` relationship (sorted via `ContactQuery`), or use a separate `@Query` with a predicate for the selected group so filtering happens in SwiftData instead of in-memory.

---
FILE: ContactManager/Views/SidebarView.swift:41
BODY: The group list shows a badge via `group.contacts.count`. In SwiftData this can force loading each group’s contacts relationship just to compute a count, which may become expensive with many groups/contacts. Consider storing a denormalized count, fetching counts via an aggregate query, or deferring count display until the group is selected.
---
FILE: ContactManager/Views/ContactDetailView.swift:226
BODY: The group membership toggles persist changes with `try? context.save()`, which discards save errors and can leave the toggle state inconsistent with what’s actually persisted. Consider handling the save result (show an alert / revert the toggle / rollback) similarly to how other explicit actions surface errors.
---
FILE: ContactManager/Support/VCard.swift:49
BODY: `birthdayFormatter` is configured with a fixed UTC timezone. Because `Contact.birthday` is stored as a `Date` (an absolute moment), formatting/parsing in UTC can shift the displayed day for users in non-UTC time zones (e.g., exporting a locally-selected birthday may serialize as the previous/next day). To preserve date-only semantics, format and parse using the user’s current calendar/timezone (or convert to year/month/day components and serialize those) rather than forcing UTC.

---
FILE: ContactManager/Support/VCard.swift:61
BODY: The file header states the vCard implementation is “kept free of SwiftData/UI types”, but the writing API (`makeDocument` / `card(for:)`) takes `Contact` directly. This couples `VCard` to the SwiftData model and forces vCard generation to run on the same actor/threading constraints as the model. Consider introducing a pure value type for writing (e.g., reuse `ParsedContact` or a separate DTO) and mapping in the UI layer, to match the stated design and improve testability/reuse.
---
FILE: ContactManager/Support/VCard.swift:93
BODY: The writer currently emits each property as a single physical line and doesn’t implement vCard 3.0 line folding (75-octet wrapping) even though the file is labeled “Escaping & folding” and the PR description/test plan mention folding behavior. Some consumers expect folded output for long NOTE/ADR/etc lines. Consider adding folding when serializing lines (and ensure tests cover folding on write as well as unfold on read).
---

```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/scottdensmore/Developer/scottdensmore/contactmanager/ContactManager/Support/VCard.swift",
  "old_string": "        lines.append(\"END:VCARD\")\n        return lines.joined(separator: lineEnding) + lineEnding\n    }",
  "new_string": "        lines.append(\"END:VCARD\")\n        return lines.map(fold).joined(separator: lineEnding) + lineEnding\n    }\n\n    /// Folds a logical line to the vCard 3.0 75-octet limit. Continuation\n    /// lines begin with a single space, which `unfold` strips on read.\n    private static func fold(_ line: String) -> String {\n        let limit = 75\n        guard line.utf8.count > limit else { return line }\n\n        var folded = \"\"\n        var segment = \"\"\n        var octets = 0\n        var isFirstSegment = true\n\n        for character in line {\n            let charOctets = String(character).utf8.count\n            // Continuation lines spend one octet on the leading space.\n            let segmentLimit = isFirstSegment ? limit : limit - 1\n            if octets + charOctets > segmentLimit {\n                folded += (isFirstSegment ? \"\" : \" \") + segment + lineEnding\n                isFirstSegment = false\n                segment = \"\"\n                octets = 0\n            }\n            segment.append(character)\n            octets += charOctets\n        }\n        folded += (isFirstSegment ? \"\" : \" \") + segment\n        return folded\n    }"
}

{

  "old_string": "    private func handleImport(_ result: Result<URL, Error>) {\n        switch result {\n        case .failure(let error):\n            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n        case .success(let url):\n            let didAccess = url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()\n            defer { if didAccess { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() } }\n\n            guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),\n                  let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else {\n                errorMessage = \"That file couldn't be read as a vCard.\"\n                return\n            }\n\n            let parsed = VCard.parse(text)\n            guard !parsed.isEmpty else {\n                errorMessage = \"No contacts were found in that file.\"\n                return\n            }\n\n            for card in parsed {\n                context.insert(makeContact(from: card))\n            }\n            do { try context.save() } catch { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription }\n        }\n    }",
  "new_string": "    private func handleImport(_ result: Result<URL, Error>) {\n        switch result {\n        case .failure(let error):\n            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n        case .success(let url):\n            Task {\n                // Read and parse off the main actor so large files don't block UI.\n                let parsed: [ParsedContact]? = await Task.detached {\n                    let didAccess = url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()\n                    defer { if didAccess { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() } }\n                    guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),\n                          let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else { return nil }\n                    return VCard.parse(text)\n                }.value\n\n                guard let parsed else {\n                    errorMessage = \"That file couldn't be read as a vCard.\"\n                    return\n                }\n                guard !parsed.isEmpty else {\n                    errorMessage = \"No contacts were found in that file.\"\n                    return\n                }\n\n                for card in parsed {\n                    context.insert(makeContact(from: card))\n                }\n                do {\n                    try context.save()\n                } catch {\n                    // Drop the just-inserted, unsaved contacts.\n                    context.rollback()\n                    errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }"
}

1	# Contact Manager
2	
3	**ContactManager** is a native macOS contact manager built with **SwiftUI** and **SwiftData**, targeting the modern macOS Tahoe (macOS 26) look and feel. It is **100% self-contained** with zero third-party dependencies.
4	
5	The app was originally an Objective-C / AppKit / Core Data demo and is being rebuilt, in focused increments, into a polished native Tahoe application.
6	
7	---
8	
9	## Architecture
10	
11	- **Platform**: macOS 26.0+ (Tahoe)
12	- **UI**: SwiftUI — a three-column `NavigationSplitView` (sidebar / contact list / detail) that automatically adopts the Liquid Glass appearance when built against the macOS 26 SDK.
13	- **Persistence**: SwiftData (`@Model`, `ModelContainer`, `@Query`), replacing the legacy Core Data stack.
14	- **Language**: Swift
15	- **Testing**: Swift Testing, backed by an in-memory `ModelContainer`.

## What shipped this session
| PR | Title | Highlights |
|----|-------|-----------|
| #9 | Foundation | ObjC/AppKit/Core Data → **Swift + SwiftUI + SwiftData** on macOS 26; three-column `NavigationSplitView`; CRUD; Swift Testing |
| #11 | Richer fields | `ContactField` (labeled emails/phones), company/title/address/birthday/notes; in-place migration |
| #12 | Search & sections | Live search, alphabetical sections (`#` group), Last/First sort toggle |
| #13 | Contact photos | External-storage photos, photo well, off-main downscaling, initials fallback |
| #14 | Groups & vCard | Many-to-many groups with sidebar CRUD; pure vCard 3.0 reader/writer + File import/export |
| #15 | Tahoe polish | Glass-prominent buttons, list/selection/avatar animations, min window size |

## How it went
- Every PR followed your workflow: focused branch → build clean (zero code warnings) → tests green → headless launch check → open PR → **address every Copilot review comment** → merge. In total I resolved ~20 review comments (error handling, off-main work, a stable avatar color, vCard birthday-timezone and line-folding correctness, accessibility, and more).
- Migrations were verified end-to-end (including replaying a real prior-schema store via a worktree).
- The `.pbxproj` was restructured with the Ruby `xcodeproj` gem throughout, never hand-edited.

## Two honest caveats
- **No visual confirmation**: this environment has no display access, so I verified via build/test/headless-launch but couldn't see the rendered UI. A pass with `⌘R` to eyeball the Liquid Glass styling, animations, photo picker, groups, and vCard round-trip is worth doing.
- **Liquid Glass scope**: `.glassEffect()`/`GlassEffectContainer` aren't in the macOS 26.5 SwiftUI interface here, so explicit glass is via the glass *button styles* — the broader look comes from automatic SDK adoption on the toolbar/sidebar.

Possible next directions (all net-new beyond the roadmap): CloudKit sync, duplicate detection/merge, vCard `PHOTO` round-tripping, or a detail **inspector** column. Happy to take any of these on — just say the word.

> AGENT

Found it. Your session is hosted by **Terminal.app**:

```
Terminal.app → login → zsh → claude → zsh → (my shell) → screencapture
```

`screencapture` runs as a child of Terminal, so macOS attributes the **Screen Recording** permission to *Terminal* — and it isn't granted, which is why capture fails (`could not create image from display`). It's a permissions issue, not a "no display" issue (the app windows launch fine).

## How to grant it

1. **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording** (on recent macOS it's listed as **"Screen & System Audio Recording"**).
2. Turn on (or add with **+**) **Terminal**.
3. **Quit and reopen Terminal**, then start Claude Code again.

That third step is the catch: macOS only applies the new Screen Recording permission to the host app after it's **restarted** — and restarting Terminal ends this Claude session. So this sets things up for *future* sessions; it won't unlock capture mid-conversation here.

I can deep-link you straight to the right pane (harmless — just opens Settings). Want me to run it?
```bash
open "x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_ScreenCapture"
```

## Two more notes
- **Window control** (e.g., the AppleScript I used to resize/position the app window) needs a *separate* permission: **Privacy & Security → Accessibility → Terminal**. Grant that too if you want me to frame specific windows. Plain full-screen `screencapture -x` only needs Screen Recording.
- **Alternatives if you'd rather not restart now:**
  - Use a terminal you don't mind restarting (or one already granted the permission), then relaunch Claude there.
  - Or, for a one-off, *you* capture it — type `!screencapture -x ~/Desktop/cm.png` in the prompt after the app is open (it runs in your session) — though that inherits the same Terminal permission, so it needs the grant + restart too.

Once Terminal has Screen Recording and you've relaunched, I'll be able to build, launch the app, and screenshot it to visually verify the Tahoe styling, animations, photo picker, and groups/vCard flows. Want me to open the Settings pane for you?

> AGENT

SwiftLint and SwiftFormat partly conflict on trailing commas (SwiftFormat adds them in multiline literals — the modern, diff-friendly convention — while SwiftLint's default forbids them), so I'll let SwiftFormat own comma style. A few flags are genuine idiom fixes (`l`/`r` names, a 168-char line, a lossy `Data`→`String`); the parser switch's "complexity" is a benign false positive.

1	//
2	//  ContactQuery.swift
3	//  ContactManager
4	//
5	//  Pure, testable helpers for filtering, sorting, and sectioning contacts.
6	//  Keeping this logic out of the views makes it straightforward to unit test.
7	//
8	
9	import Foundation
10	
11	/// The order contacts are sorted and grouped by.
12	enum ContactSortOrder: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
13	    case lastName
14	    case firstName
15	
16	    var id: String { rawValue }
17	
18	    var title: String {
19	        switch self {
20	        case .lastName: return "Last Name"
21	        case .firstName: return "First Name"
22	        }
23	    }
24	}
25	
26	/// An alphabetical group of contacts, titled by initial ("A"…"Z" or "#").
27	struct ContactSection: Identifiable {
28	    let title: String
29	    let contacts: [Contact]
30	    var id: String { title }
31	}
32	
33	enum ContactQuery {
34	    /// Sorts contacts by the given order's primary key, then its secondary key.
35	    static func sorted(_ contacts: [Contact], by order: ContactSortOrder = .lastName) -> [Contact] {
36	        contacts.sorted { lhs, rhs in
37	            let l = lhs.sortKeys(for: order)
38	            let r = rhs.sortKeys(for: order)
39	            if l.primary != r.primary {
40	                return l.primary < r.primary
41	            }
42	            return l.secondary < r.secondary
43	        }
44	    }
45	
46	    /// Filters contacts whose name, company, job title, notes, or any email/
47	    /// phone field value contains the query. An empty query returns every
48	    /// contact unchanged.
49	    static func filtered(_ contacts: [Contact], matching query: String) -> [Contact] {
50	        let needle = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
51	        guard !needle.isEmpty else { return contacts }
52	
53	        return contacts.filter { contact in
54	            let haystacks = [
55	                contact.fullName,
56	                contact.company,
57	                contact.jobTitle,
58	                contact.notes,
59	            ] + contact.fields.map(\.value)
60	
61	            return haystacks.contains { $0.lowercased().contains(needle) }
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    /// Groups contacts into alphabetical sections by their initial, sorted
66	    /// within each section. Names that don't start with a letter land in a
67	    /// trailing "#" section.
68	    static func sections(_ contacts: [Contact], by order: ContactSortOrder = .lastName) -> [ContactSection] {
69	        let ordered = sorted(contacts, by: order)
70	        let grouped = Dictionary(grouping: ordered) { sectionTitle(for: $0, order: order) }
71	
72	        let titles = grouped.keys.sorted { lhs, rhs in
73	            if lhs == "#" { return false }   // "#" always sorts last
74	            if rhs == "#" { return true }
75	            return lhs < rhs
76	        }
77	
78	        return titles.map { ContactSection(title: $0, contacts: grouped[$0] ?? []) }
79	    }
80	
81	    private static func sectionTitle(for contact: Contact, order: ContactSortOrder) -> String {
82	        guard let first = contact.sortKeys(for: order).primary.first, first.isLetter else {
83	            return "#"
84	        }
85	        return String(first).uppercased()
86	    }
87	}
88

10	import Foundation

12	/// A contact decoded from a vCard, independent of SwiftData.
13	struct ParsedContact: Equatable {
14	    var firstName = ""
15	    var lastName = ""
16	    var company = ""
17	    var jobTitle = ""
18	    var notes = ""
19	    var birthday: Date?
20	    var street = ""
21	    var city = ""
22	    var state = ""
23	    var postalCode = ""
24	    var country = ""
25	    var emails: [(label: FieldLabel, value: String)] = []
26	    var phones: [(label: FieldLabel, value: String)] = []
27	
28	    static func == (lhs: ParsedContact, rhs: ParsedContact) -> Bool {
29	        lhs.firstName == rhs.firstName && lhs.lastName == rhs.lastName
30	            && lhs.company == rhs.company && lhs.jobTitle == rhs.jobTitle
31	            && lhs.notes == rhs.notes && lhs.birthday == rhs.birthday
32	            && lhs.street == rhs.street && lhs.city == rhs.city
33	            && lhs.state == rhs.state && lhs.postalCode == rhs.postalCode
34	            && lhs.country == rhs.country
35	            && lhs.emails.map(\.value) == rhs.emails.map(\.value)
36	            && lhs.emails.map(\.label) == rhs.emails.map(\.label)
37	            && lhs.phones.map(\.value) == rhs.phones.map(\.value)
38	            && lhs.phones.map(\.label) == rhs.phones.map(\.label)
39	    }
40	}
41	
42	enum VCard {
43	    private static let lineEnding = "\r\n"
44	
45	    private static let birthdayFormatter: DateFormatter = {
46	        let formatter = DateFormatter()
47	        formatter.locale = Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")
48	        formatter.dateFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd"
49	        // Use the local time zone so the serialized day matches the day the
50	        // user picked (birthdays are date-only, stored as a local midnight).
51	        formatter.timeZone = .autoupdatingCurrent
52	        return formatter
53	    }()
54	
55	    // MARK: - Writing
56	
57	    /// Serializes contacts into a single vCard document.
58	    static func makeDocument(from contacts: [Contact]) -> String {
59	        contacts.map(card(for:)).joined()
60	    }
61	
62	    static func card(for contact: Contact) -> String {
63	        var lines = ["BEGIN:VCARD", "VERSION:3.0"]
64	
65	        let last = escape(contact.lastName)
66	        let first = escape(contact.firstName)
67	        lines.append("N:\(last);\(first);;;")
68	        lines.append("FN:\(escape(contact.fullName))")
69	
70	        if !contact.company.isEmpty { lines.append("ORG:\(escape(contact.company))") }
71	        if !contact.jobTitle.isEmpty { lines.append("TITLE:\(escape(contact.jobTitle))") }
72	
73	        for email in contact.emails where !email.value.isEmpty {
74	            lines.append("EMAIL;TYPE=\(typeName(email.label)):\(escape(email.value))")
75	        }
76	        for phone in contact.phones where !phone.value.isEmpty {
77	            lines.append("TEL;TYPE=\(typeName(phone.label)):\(escape(phone.value))")
78	        }
79	
80	        if hasAddress(contact) {
81	            let parts = [contact.street, contact.city, contact.state, contact.postalCode, contact.country]
82	                .map(escape)
83	            lines.append("ADR;TYPE=HOME:;;\(parts.joined(separator: ";"))")
84	        }
85	
86	        if let birthday = contact.birthday {
87	            lines.append("BDAY:\(birthdayFormatter.string(from: birthday))")
88	        }
89	        if !contact.notes.isEmpty {
90	            lines.append("NOTE:\(escape(contact.notes))")
91	        }
92	
93	        lines.append("END:VCARD")
94	        return lines.map(fold).joined(separator: lineEnding) + lineEnding
95	    }
96	
97	    /// Folds a logical line to the vCard 3.0 75-octet limit. Continuation
98	    /// lines begin with a single space, which `unfold` strips on read.
99	    private static func fold(_ line: String) -> String {
100	        let limit = 75
101	        guard line.utf8.count > limit else { return line }
102	
103	        var folded = ""
104	        var segment = ""
105	        var octets = 0
106	        var isFirstSegment = true
107	
108	        for character in line {
109	            let charOctets = String(character).utf8.count
110	            // Continuation lines spend one octet on the leading space.
111	            let segmentLimit = isFirstSegment ? limit : limit - 1
112	            if octets + charOctets > segmentLimit {
113	                folded += (isFirstSegment ? "" : " ") + segment + lineEnding
114	                isFirstSegment = false
115	                segment = ""
116	                octets = 0
117	            }
118	            segment.append(character)
119	            octets += charOctets
120	        }
121	        folded += (isFirstSegment ? "" : " ") + segment
122	        return folded
123	    }
124	
125	    // MARK: - Reading
126	
127	    /// Parses one or more vCards from a document.
128	    static func parse(_ text: String) -> [ParsedContact] {
129	        var results: [ParsedContact] = []
130	        var current: ParsedContact?
131	
132	        for line in unfold(text) {
133	            let upper = line.uppercased()
134	            if upper == "BEGIN:VCARD" {
135	                current = ParsedContact()
136	            } else if upper == "END:VCARD" {
137	                if let card = current { results.append(card) }
138	                current = nil
139	            } else if current != nil {
140	                apply(line: line, to: &current!)
141	            }
142	        }
143	        return results
144	    }
145	
146	    private static func apply(line: String, to card: inout ParsedContact) {
147	        guard let colon = line.firstIndex(of: ":") else { return }
148	        let descriptor = String(line[line.startIndex..<colon])
149	        let value = String(line[line.index(after: colon)...])
150	
151	        let segments = descriptor.uppercased().split(separator: ";").map(String.init)
152	        guard let property = segments.first else { return }
153	        let params = Array(segments.dropFirst())
154	
155	        switch property {
156	        case "N":
157	            let comps = splitStructured(value)
158	            card.lastName = comps.count > 0 ? comps[0] : ""
159	            card.firstName = comps.count > 1 ? comps[1] : ""
160	        case "FN":
161	            // Only use FN for names if N didn't provide them.
162	            if card.firstName.isEmpty && card.lastName.isEmpty {
163	                let unescaped = unescape(value)
164	                let pieces = unescaped.split(separator: " ", maxSplits: 1).map(String.init)
165	                card.firstName = pieces.first ?? unescaped
166	                card.lastName = pieces.count > 1 ? pieces[1] : ""
167	            }
168	        case "ORG":
169	            card.company = splitStructured(value).first ?? unescape(value)
170	        case "TITLE":
171	            card.jobTitle = unescape(value)
172	        case "EMAIL":
173	            card.emails.append((label(from: params), unescape(value)))
174	        case "TEL":
175	            card.phones.append((label(from: params), unescape(value)))
176	        case "ADR":
177	            let comps = splitStructured(value)
178	            // ADR: pobox;ext;street;city;state;postal;country
179	            card.street = comps.count > 2 ? comps[2] : ""
180	            card.city = comps.count > 3 ? comps[3] : ""
181	            card.state = comps.count > 4 ? comps[4] : ""
182	            card.postalCode = comps.count > 5 ? comps[5] : ""
183	            card.country = comps.count > 6 ? comps[6] : ""
184	        case "BDAY":
185	            card.birthday = birthdayFormatter.date(from: String(value.prefix(10)))
186	        case "NOTE":
187	            card.notes = unescape(value)
188	        default:
189	            break
190	        }
191	    }
192	
193	    // MARK: - Label mapping
194	
195	    private static func typeName(_ label: FieldLabel) -> String {
196	        switch label {
197	        case .home: return "HOME"
198	        case .work: return "WORK"
199	        case .mobile: return "CELL"
200	        case .main: return "MAIN"
201	        case .other: return "OTHER"
202	        }
203	    }
204	
205	    private static func label(from params: [String]) -> FieldLabel {
206	        let types = params
207	            .flatMap { $0.replacingOccurrences(of: "TYPE=", with: "").split(separator: ",") }
208	            .map { String($0).uppercased() }
209	        if types.contains("CELL") || types.contains("MOBILE") { return .mobile }
210	        if types.contains("WORK") { return .work }
211	        if types.contains("HOME") { return .home }
212	        if types.contains("MAIN") { return .main }
213	        return .other
214	    }
215	
216	    // MARK: - Escaping & folding
217	
218	    private static func escape(_ value: String) -> String {
219	        value
220	            .replacingOccurrences(of: "\\", with: "\\\\")
221	            .replacingOccurrences(of: "\n", with: "\\n")
222	            .replacingOccurrences(of: ",", with: "\\,")
223	            .replacingOccurrences(of: ";", with: "\\;")
224	    }
225	
226	    private static func unescape(_ value: String) -> String {
227	        var result = ""
228	        var iterator = value.makeIterator()
229	        while let char = iterator.next() {
230	            if char == "\\", let next = iterator.next() {
231	                switch next {
232	                case "n", "N": result.append("\n")
233	                default: result.append(next)
234	                }
235	            } else {
236	                result.append(char)
237	            }
238	        }
239	        return result
240	    }
241	
242	    /// Splits a structured value (`;`-separated) honoring escaped separators,
243	    /// unescaping each component.
244	    private static func splitStructured(_ value: String) -> [String] {
245	        var components: [String] = []
246	        var current = ""
247	        var iterator = value.makeIterator()
248	        while let char = iterator.next() {
249	            if char == "\\", let next = iterator.next() {
250	                if next == "n" || next == "N" { current.append("\n") } else { current.append(next) }
251	            } else if char == ";" {
252	                components.append(current)
253	                current = ""
254	            } else {
255	                current.append(char)
256	            }
257	        }
258	        components.append(current)
259	        return components
260	    }
261	
262	    /// Unfolds wrapped lines (continuation lines start with a space or tab).
263	    private static func unfold(_ text: String) -> [String] {
264	        let rawLines = text.replacingOccurrences(of: "\r\n", with: "\n").components(separatedBy: "\n")
265	        var lines: [String] = []
266	        for raw in rawLines {
267	            if let first = raw.first, first == " " || first == "\t", !lines.isEmpty {
268	                lines[lines.count - 1] += raw.dropFirst()
269	            } else {
270	                lines.append(raw)
271	            }
272	        }
273	        return lines.filter { !$0.isEmpty }
274	    }
275	
276	    private static func hasAddress(_ contact: Contact) -> Bool {
277	        ![contact.street, contact.city, contact.state, contact.postalCode, contact.country]
278	            .allSatisfy(\.isEmpty)
279	    }
280	}

5	//  A tiny FileDocument wrapping vCard text, used by the export file dialog.

7	
8	import SwiftUI
9	import UniformTypeIdentifiers
10	
11	struct VCardDocument: FileDocument {
12	    static var readableContentTypes: [UTType] { [.vCard] }
13	    static var writableContentTypes: [UTType] { [.vCard] }
14	
15	    var text: String
16	
17	    init(text: String) {
18	        self.text = text
19	    }
20	
21	    init(configuration: ReadConfiguration) throws {
22	        let data = configuration.file.regularFileContents ?? Data()
23	        text = String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self)
24	    }
25	
26	    func fileWrapper(configuration: WriteConfiguration) throws -> FileWrapper {
27	        FileWrapper(regularFileWithContents: Data(text.utf8))
28	    }
29	}

186	    private func handleImport(_ result: Result<URL, Error>) {
187	        switch result {
188	        case .failure(let error):
189	            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
190	        case .success(let url):
191	            Task {
192	                // Read and parse off the main actor so large files don't block UI.
193	                let parsed: [ParsedContact]? = await Task.detached {
194	                    let didAccess = url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()
195	                    defer { if didAccess { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() } }
196	                    guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),
197	                          let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else { return nil }
198	                    return VCard.parse(text)
199	                }.value
200	
201	                guard let parsed else {
202	                    errorMessage = "That file couldn't be read as a vCard."
203	                    return
204	                }
205	                guard !parsed.isEmpty else {
206	                    errorMessage = "No contacts were found in that file."
207	                    return
208	                }
209	
210	                for card in parsed {
211	                    context.insert(makeContact(from: card))
212	                }
213	                do {
214	                    try context.save()
215	                } catch {
216	                    // Drop the just-inserted, unsaved contacts.
217	                    context.rollback()
218	                    errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
219	                }
220	            }
221	        }
222	    }
223	
224	    private func makeContact(from parsed: ParsedContact) -> Contact {
225	        let contact = Contact(
226	            firstName: parsed.firstName, lastName: parsed.lastName,
227	            company: parsed.company, jobTitle: parsed.jobTitle,
228	            street: parsed.street, city: parsed.city, state: parsed.state,
229	            postalCode: parsed.postalCode, country: parsed.country,
230	            birthday: parsed.birthday, notes: parsed.notes
231	        )
232	        var fields: [ContactField] = []
233	        for (index, email) in parsed.emails.enumerated() {
234	            fields.append(ContactField(kind: .email, label: email.label, value: email.value, sortIndex: index))
235	        }
236	        for (index, phone) in parsed.phones.enumerated() {
237	            fields.append(ContactField(kind: .phone, label: phone.label, value: phone.value, sortIndex: index))
238	        }
239	        contact.fields = fields
240	        return contact
241	    }
242	}

44	    init(
45	        firstName: String = "",
46	        lastName: String = "",
47	        company: String = "",
48	        jobTitle: String = "",
49	        street: String = "",
50	        city: String = "",
51	        state: String = "",
52	        postalCode: String = "",
53	        country: String = "",
54	        birthday: Date? = nil,
55	        notes: String = "",
56	        createdAt: Date = .now
57	    ) {
58	        self.firstName = firstName
59	        self.lastName = lastName
60	        self.company = company
61	        self.jobTitle = jobTitle
62	        self.street = street
63	        self.city = city
64	        self.state = state
65	        self.postalCode = postalCode
66	        self.country = country
67	        self.birthday = birthday
68	        self.notes = notes
69	        self.createdAt = createdAt
70	        self.fields = []
71	    }
72	}
73	
74	extension Contact {
75	    /// Human-readable name, falling back to company, then a placeholder.
76	    var fullName: String {
77	        let name = [firstName, lastName]
78	            .map { $0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) }
79	            .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
80	            .joined(separator: " ")
81	        if !name.isEmpty { return name }
82	        let trimmedCompany = company.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
83	        return trimmedCompany.isEmpty ? "New Contact" : trimmedCompany
84	    }
85	
86	    /// One or two uppercase letters used for the avatar placeholder.
87	    var initials: String {
88	        let first = firstName.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).first.map(String.init) ?? ""
89	        let last = lastName.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).first.map(String.init) ?? ""
90	        var combined = (first + last).uppercased()
91	        if combined.isEmpty {
92	            combined = company.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).first.map { String($0).uppercased() } ?? ""
93	        }
94	        return combined.isEmpty ? "#" : combined
95	    }
96	
97	    /// Lowercased key used to sort contacts: last name, then first name, then
98	    /// company. Falling back to company keeps sorting/sectioning aligned with
99	    /// the displayed `fullName` for company-only contacts.
100	    var sortKey: String {
101	        for candidate in [lastName, firstName, company] {
102	            let trimmed = candidate.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
103	            if !trimmed.isEmpty { return trimmed.lowercased() }
104	        }
105	        return ""
106	    }
107	
108	    /// Lowercased first name, trimmed — used as the secondary sort key so it
109	    /// stays consistent with `sortKey`.
110	    var firstNameSortKey: String {
111	        firstName.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).lowercased()
112	    }
113	
114	    /// Deterministic, launch-stable seed for the avatar tint. Derived from the
115	    /// persisted creation date so the color survives relaunches (unlike
116	    /// `hashValue`, which is per-process) and doesn't shift when the name is
117	    /// edited.
118	    var colorSeed: Int {
119	        Int(truncatingIfNeeded: createdAt.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate.bitPattern)
120	    }
121	
122	    /// Primary/secondary keys for a given sort order. The primary key also
123	    /// drives alphabetical section grouping.
124	    func sortKeys(for order: ContactSortOrder) -> (primary: String, secondary: String) {
125	        switch order {
126	        case .lastName:
127	            return (sortKey, firstNameSortKey)
128	        case .firstName:
129	            let first = firstNameSortKey
130	            return (first.isEmpty ? sortKey : first, sortKey)
131	        }
132	    }
133	
134	    // MARK: - Field helpers
135	
136	    var emails: [ContactField] { fields(of: .email) }
137	    var phones: [ContactField] { fields(of: .phone) }
138	
139	    func fields(of kind: FieldKind) -> [ContactField] {
140	        fields
141	            .filter { $0.kind == kind }
142	            .sorted { $0.sortIndex < $1.sortIndex }
143	    }
144	
145	    /// The first non-empty email, used as the list subtitle.
146	    var primaryEmail: String? {
147	        emails.first { !$0.value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty }?.value
148	    }
149	
150	    /// The first non-empty phone number.
151	    var primaryPhone: String? {
152	        phones.first { !$0.value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty }?.value
153	    }
154	
155	    /// Best available secondary line for list rows: email, then phone, then company.
156	    var subtitle: String? {
157	        if let email = primaryEmail { return email }
158	        if let phone = primaryPhone { return phone }
159	        let trimmedCompany = company.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
160	        return trimmedCompany.isEmpty ? nil : trimmedCompany
161	    }
162	}

1	//
2	//  ImageProcessing.swift
3	//  ContactManager
4	//
5	//  Downscales and re-encodes picked images into compact avatar JPEGs so the
6	//  store stays lean. Uses ImageIO thumbnails for efficient decoding.
7	//
8	
9	import Foundation
10	import ImageIO
11	import UniformTypeIdentifiers
12	
13	enum ImageProcessing {
14	    /// Longest edge (in pixels) of a generated avatar.
15	    static let maxPixelSize: CGFloat = 512
16	
17	    /// JPEG compression quality for generated avatars.
18	    static let compressionQuality: Double = 0.8
19	
20	    /// Reads an image file and returns a downscaled avatar JPEG, or `nil` if
21	    /// the file isn't a decodable image.
22	    static func avatarData(from url: URL) -> Data? {
23	        guard let source = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(url as CFURL, nil) else { return nil }
24	        return avatarData(from: source)
25	    }
26	
27	    /// Returns a downscaled avatar JPEG for the given image data, or `nil` if
28	    /// the data isn't a decodable image.
29	    static func avatarData(from data: Data) -> Data? {
30	        guard let source = CGImageSourceCreateWithData(data as CFData, nil) else { return nil }
31	        return avatarData(from: source)
32	    }
33	
34	    private static func avatarData(from source: CGImageSource) -> Data? {
35	        let options: [CFString: Any] = [
36	            kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailFromImageAlways: true,
37	            kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true,
38	            kCGImageSourceThumbnailMaxPixelSize: maxPixelSize,
39	        ]
40	        guard let thumbnail = CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex(source, 0, options as CFDictionary) else {
41	            return nil
42	        }
43	
44	        let output = NSMutableData()
45	        guard let destination = CGImageDestinationCreateWithData(
46	            output, UTType.jpeg.identifier as CFString, 1, nil
47	        ) else { return nil }
48	
49	        CGImageDestinationAddImage(
50	            destination, thumbnail,
51	            [kCGImageDestinationLossyCompressionQuality: compressionQuality] as CFDictionary
52	        )
53	        guard CGImageDestinationFinalize(destination) else { return nil }
54	        return output as Data
55	    }
56	}
57

  "content": "# ContactManager — Contributor & Agent Guide\n\nNative **macOS Tahoe (macOS 26)** contact manager built with **SwiftUI + SwiftData**.\nZero third-party *runtime* dependencies. Code here is reviewed by humans, not just\nagents — keep it readable and idiomatic.\n\n## Commands\n\n| Task | Command |\n| --- | --- |\n| Build | `make build` |\n| Test | `make test` |\n| Lint | `make lint` (autofix: `make lint-fix`) |\n| Format | `make format` (check only: `make format-check`) |\n| Pre-PR gate | `make check` (format-check + lint + test) |\n| Install tooling | `make bootstrap` (runs `brew bundle`) |\n\nTests use **Swift Testing** (`import Testing`, `@Test`, `#expect`/`#require`) — not XCTest.\n\n## Layout\n\n```\nContactManager/App/      @main entry, ModelContainer, menu commands\nContactManager/Models/   SwiftData @Models + pure helpers (ContactQuery)\nContactManager/Support/  Non-UI utilities (VCard, ImageProcessing, VCardDocument)\nContactManager/Views/    SwiftUI views\nContactManagerTests/     Swift Testing suites\n```\n\n## Code style\n\nRun `make format` and `make lint` before committing; both must pass. Configs:\n`.swiftformat`, `.swiftlint.yml` (SwiftLint also runs as a build phase).\n\n- 4-space indent; opening braces on the same line; trailing commas in multiline\n  literals (SwiftFormat owns comma style — SwiftLint's `trailing_comma` is disabled\n  so they don't fight).\n- No force-unwraps (`!`) — SwiftLint enforces `force_unwrapping`. Use `guard`/`if let`,\n  or `#require` in tests.\n- Keep views thin: put pure, testable logic in `Models/` or `Support/` and unit-test it\n  there rather than in views.\n- User-initiated actions surface persistence errors (alert + `context.rollback()`);\n  don't swallow them with `try?`.\n\n## Xcode project (`.pbxproj`)\n\nEdit it **only** via the Ruby `xcodeproj` gem — never by hand. When you add a Swift file,\nregister it on the correct target with a small ruby script (see prior commits for the\npattern), then build to confirm it compiles.\n\n## SwiftData\n\n- Top-level models must be listed in the `ModelContainer(for:)` call in\n  `ContactManagerApp.swift`: `Contact`, `ContactField`, `ContactGroup`.\n- **Migration:** every new *non-optional scalar* attribute MUST have an inline default\n  (e.g. `var city: String = \"\"`), or in-place migration fails (`NSCocoaError 134110`).\n  Optional attributes and relationships migrate cleanly. Verify by launching against an\n  existing store.\n- **Tests:** use an in-memory `ModelContainer`; the suite is `@MainActor @Suite(.serialized)`\n  and holds the container as a stored property. The app skips creating its own container\n  under tests (`XCTestConfigurationFilePath`) so the test owns the only one — keep that guard.\n\n## Platform / Liquid Glass\n\n- Toolbars and `NavigationSplitView` adopt Liquid Glass automatically on the macOS 26 SDK.\n  The `.glassEffect()` modifier / `GlassEffectContainer` are not in this SDK's SwiftUI\n  interface; use `.buttonStyle(.glass)` / `.buttonStyle(.glassProminent)` for explicit glass.\n- `SWIFT_VERSION` is 5.0 (language mode 5). Full Swift 6 strict-concurrency is a future migration.\n\n## Workflow\n\n- Ship focused, single-purpose PRs. ## Code review (idiom fixes)
- `ContactQuery`: `l`/`r` → `lhsKeys`/`rhsKeys`
- `VCard`: removed a `&current!` force-unwrap; `comps.first` instead of an index check
- `VCardDocument`: failable `String(data:encoding:)` instead of a lossy decode
- `ContentView.deleteGroup`: use the `Equatable` sidebar selection directly instead of a verbose `if/else`
- Tidied an over-long test assertion

The rest of the code reviewed as clean and idiomatic (final models, thin views with pure helpers in `Models/`/`Support/`, no force-unwraps, errors surfaced not swallowed).

## Linters / formatting
- **SwiftLint** (`.swiftlint.yml`) + **SwiftFormat** (`.swiftformat`), curated so they don't fight: SwiftFormat owns comma/brace style; SwiftLint owns idioms (enables `force_unwrapping`, `first_where`, `modifier_order`, etc.).
- SwiftLint runs as a **build phase** (warns, never blocks if missing).
- **Brewfile** installs both tools (dropped stale `carthage`); removed the deprecated lock file.
- **Makefile**: `make build | test | lint | format | format-check | check`.
- Whole codebase formatted; **`make check` is green and idempotent**, 21 tests pass.

## `CLAUDE.md`
Captures the non-obvious conventions to keep things in sync: the commands, code style, the **edit-`.pbxproj`-only-via-the-xcodeproj-gem** rule, SwiftData migration/test patterns, and the Liquid Glass API situation.

{

Remove leftover system framework references (and their link-phase entries).\nframework_names = [\"Cocoa.framework\", \"AppKit.framework\", \"CoreData.framework\", \"Foundation.framework\"]\nremoved_frameworks = []\nproject.files.select { |f| framework_names.include?(f.display_name) }.each do |ref|\n  removed_frameworks << ref.display_name\n  ref.remove_from_project\nend\n\n# 2. Remove the now-stale \"Frameworks\" navigator group (+ Other Frameworks).\nproject.main_group.children.select { |c| c.is_a?(GroupClass) && c.display_name == \"Frameworks\" }.each(&:remove_from_project)\n\n# 3. Recursively prune empty groups under the two source groups.\npruned = []\nprune = lambda do |group|\n  group.children.to_a.each do |child|\n    next unless child.is_a?(GroupClass)\n    prune.call(child)\n    if child.children.empty?\n      pruned << child.display_name\n      child.remove_from_project\n    end\n  end\nend\n[\"ContactManager\", \"ContactManagerTests\"].each { |n| (g = project.main_group[n]) && prune.call(g) }\n\n# 4. Sort the two source groups alphabetically (groups and files), for a tidy navigator.\n[\"ContactManager\", \"ContactManagerTests\"].each do |n|\n  project.main_group[n]&.sort(options: { groups_position: :above })\nend\n\nproject.save\nputs \"Removed framework refs: #{removed_frameworks.uniq.join(\", \")}\"\nputs \"Pruned empty groups:    #{pruned.join(\", \")}\"\n'",
  "description": "Clean up groups and frameworks"
}

> AGENT

Confirmed the root causes:
1. **PATH** — the script uses `command -v swiftlint`, but Xcode build phases don't get `/opt/homebrew/bin` on PATH, so it falls into the "not installed" branch.
2. **Recommended settings added `ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING = YES`** (plus `DEAD_CODE_STRIPPING`, `STRING_CATALOG_GENERATE_SYMBOLS`, `SWIFT_COMPILATION_MODE = wholemodule`). Script sandboxing blocks a whole-tree SwiftLint run-script from reading source files — so even with PATH fixed, the build-phase approach fights the recommended settings.

Let me branch (carrying your settings changes) and empirically test whether SwiftLint can run under sandboxing once PATH is fixed.

Given you want the recommended settings (and the project is zero-dependency, so the SwiftLint SPM plugin isn't a fit), the right move is to **drop the build-phase lint and keep linting via `make lint`** — sandboxing stays on, and the warning/failure goes away. ## What I found & fixed
The warning had two layers:
1. **PATH** — the run-script used `command -v swiftlint`, but Xcode build phases don't get `/opt/homebrew/bin` on PATH, so it always hit the "not installed" branch.
2. **Your recommended-settings update enabled `ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING = YES`** — I verified that even *with* PATH fixed, the sandbox denies SwiftLint read access to the whole source tree (`Sandbox: swiftlint … deny file-read-data …`) and the **build fails**. A whole-tree SwiftLint *build phase* simply can't coexist with script sandboxing.

So in **#18** I kept all your recommended settings (sandboxing on; `DEAD_CODE_STRIPPING`, `STRING_CATALOG_GENERATE_SYMBOLS`, Release `wholemodule`) and **removed the SwiftLint build phase**, moving linting to the command line (`make lint` / `make check`). Verified: Debug tests pass, Release builds, lint/format clean. (I avoided the two alternatives that would compromise your goals — disabling the recommended sandbox setting, or adding the SwiftLint SPM *plugin* to a deliberately dependency-free project.)

One trade-off: without the build phase, linting is no longer automatic on every build. How would you like to enforce it going forward?

## My recommendation
**Merge #18 as-is (command-line linting locally) and add a tiny CI lint check on PRs.** Here's the reasoning for "least friction":

- A **pre-commit hook** is *more* friction — it runs on every commit and can block you. Opposite of what you want.
- **Inline Xcode warnings** means re-adding the build phase *and* disabling a recommended setting, plus it slows every build.
- **CI** is **zero local friction**: nothing touches your builds or commits. It runs on GitHub automatically when you open/update a PR (which you already do), and surfaces failures right next to Copilot. Free on this public repo.

So: keep coding with no local overhead; CI quietly enforces formatting + lint on PRs. Let me add it to #18 and verify it before merging.

## What I did (**PR #18**, merged)
- **Removed the SwiftLint build phase.** That was the source of the warning, and it can't coexist with the `ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING = YES` you enabled (the sandbox blocks it from reading your sources — I confirmed it actually *fails* the build, not just warns).
- **Kept all your recommended settings** — sandboxing, `DEAD_CODE_STRIPPING`, `STRING_CATALOG_GENERATE_SYMBOLS`, and Release `wholemodule` (correctly Release-only).
- **Added a CI lint check** (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) that runs SwiftFormat + SwiftLint on PRs. It passed on the PR (19s) and on `main` (24s).

## Why this is the least-friction choice
- **Locally:** nothing changed — no build slowdown, no commit hook, no warnings. You just code and build.
- **Enforcement:** happens automatically on GitHub when you open a PR (which you already do), right alongside Copilot. Free on this public repo.
- A pre-commit hook would've added friction to every commit; inline Xcode warnings would've meant undoing a recommended setting and slowing builds. CI avoids both.

So: open Xcode, build — clean, no warning. Push a branch / open a PR — CI quietly checks formatting and lint for you.

I also noted your preference (recommend decisively, favor low-friction) so I'll default to that going forward rather than handing you option menus. Anything else on the project, or back to features?

> AGENT

That's the classic symptom of `SWIFT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL` not being `-Onone` for Debug — SwiftUI previews require `-Onone`. When this project was converted from Objective-C it never got the standard per-configuration Swift settings (the old project only had the *GCC* optimization flag), so Debug is falling back to the build-system default of `-O`. Let me confirm the effective values.

The fix is the standard per-configuration Swift setting. Let me branch and apply it at the project level (so both targets inherit).

> AGENT

Fixed and merged (**#20**).

**The cause:** because this project was converted from Objective-C, it never had `SWIFT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL` set — only the legacy *GCC* optimization flag. With it unset, Debug fell back to the build-system default of `-O`, and SwiftUI `#Preview` requires `-Onone`.

**The fix:** set it explicitly per configuration at the project level (both targets inherit):
- **Debug** → `-Onone` (previews work)
- **Release** → `-O` (still whole-module)

Verified: `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` now reports `-Onone` for Debug, the Debug build + 21 tests pass, and CI is green. I also recorded the per-config settings in `CLAUDE.md`.

Reopen the canvas/preview in Xcode (or hit the resume button) and the `ContentView` preview should build now. One note: previews use the in-memory container (`.modelContainer(for: Contact.self, inMemory: true)`), so it'll render empty — add a sample contact in the preview if you want to see populated UI. Want me to wire up a richer preview with seeded sample data?

> DEVELOPER

Before adding new features: we should make sure we have plenty of tests and tests for critical user journys

> AGENT

Good call — before new features, lock in the behavior with tests, especially the end-to-end journeys. Right now most of our 21 tests cover *pure helpers and model derivations*. The critical journey logic — create/edit/delete, group membership + filtering, and vCard import/export mapping — currently lives **inside the views** (`ContentView`/`ContactDetailView`), where it can't be tested.

So the highest-value move is to **extract that logic into a small testable `ContactStore`** (which also makes the views thinner, per our CLAUDE.md convention) and then write journey tests against it with an in-memory store. That gives reliable, fast end-to-end coverage of the real code — better than flaky XCUITests, and it fits the project's Swift Testing + in-memory SwiftData approach.

Let me branch and build the store.

  "content": "//\n//  ContactStore.swift\n//  ContactManager\n//\n//  The data layer for the contact manager: every create/edit/delete,\n//  group, and vCard operation goes through here so the views stay thin and\n//  the logic is unit-testable against an in-memory ModelContext.\n//\n//  Each mutating operation saves and, on failure, rolls back so the context\n//  is left consistent and the caller can surface the thrown error.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftData\n\n@MainActor\nstruct ContactStore {\n    let context: ModelContext\n\n    init(_ context: ModelContext) {\n        self.context = context\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Contacts\n\n    /// Creates an empty contact, optionally adding it to a group.\n    @discardableResult\n    func createContact(in group: ContactGroup? = nil) throws -> Contact {\n        let contact = Contact()\n        if let group {\n            contact.groups = [group]\n        }\n        context.insert(contact)\n        try saveOrRollback()\n        return contact\n    }\n\n    func delete(_ contact: Contact) throws {\n        context.delete(contact)\n        try saveOrRollback()\n    }\n\n    func setPhotoData(_ data: Data?, on contact: Contact) throws {\n        contact.photoData = data\n        try saveOrRollback()\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Fields (emails / phones)\n\n    /// Adds an empty labeled field, keeping `sortIndex` strictly increasing so\n    /// order is stable even after deletions.\n    @discardableResult\n    func addField(_ kind: FieldKind, to contact: Contact) throws -> ContactField {\n        let nextIndex = (contact.fields(of: kind).map(\\.sortIndex).max() ?? -1) + 1\n        let field = ContactField(kind: kind, label: kind.defaultLabel, sortIndex: nextIndex)\n        field.contact = contact\n        context.insert(field)\n        try saveOrRollback()\n        return field\n    }\n\n    func delete(_ fields: [ContactField]) throws {\n        fields.forEach(context.delete)\n        try saveOrRollback()\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Groups\n\n    @discardableResult\n    func createGroup(named name: String = \"New Group\") throws -> ContactGroup {\n        let group = ContactGroup(name: name)\n        context.insert(group)\n        try saveOrRollback()\n        return group\n    }\n\n    /// Renames a group, ignoring blank names.\n    func rename(_ group: ContactGroup, to name: String) throws {\n        let trimmed = name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)\n        guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }\n        group.name = trimmed\n        try saveOrRollback()\n    }\n\n    func delete(_ group: ContactGroup) throws {\n        context.delete(group)\n        try saveOrRollback()\n    }\n\n    func setMembership(of contact: Contact, in group: ContactGroup, isMember: Bool) throws {\n        let alreadyMember = contact.groups.contains { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID }\n        if isMember, !alreadyMember {\n            contact.groups.append(group)\n        } else if !isMember {\n            contact.groups.removeAll { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID }\n        }\n        try saveOrRollback()\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - vCard import / export\n\n    /// Parses a vCard document and inserts the contacts it describes.\n    @discardableResult\n    func importVCards(from text: String) throws -> [Contact] {\n        try importContacts(VCard.parse(text))\n    }\n\n    /// Inserts contacts built from already-parsed vCards. (Parsing can be done\n    /// off the main actor by the caller; insertion happens here.)\n    @discardableResult\n    func importContacts(_ parsed: [ParsedContact]) throws -> [Contact] {\n        let contacts = parsed.map(Self.makeContact(from:))\n        contacts.forEach(context.insert)\n        try saveOrRollback()\n        return contacts\n    }\n\n    /// Serializes contacts to a vCard document, sorted for stable output.\n    func exportVCards(_ contacts: [Contact]) -> String {\n        VCard.makeDocument(from: ContactQuery.sorted(contacts))\n    }\n\n    /// Maps a parsed vCard into a new (uninserted) `Contact` with its fields.\n    static func makeContact(from parsed: ParsedContact) -> Contact {\n        let contact = Contact(\n            firstName: parsed.firstName, lastName: parsed.lastName,\n            company: parsed.company, jobTitle: parsed.jobTitle,\n            street: parsed.street, city: parsed.city, state: parsed.state,\n            postalCode: parsed.postalCode, country: parsed.country,\n            birthday: parsed.birthday, notes: parsed.notes\n        )\n        let emails = parsed.emails.enumerated().map { index, email in\n            ContactField(kind: .email, label: email.label, value: email.value, sortIndex: index)\n        }\n        let phones = parsed.phones.enumerated().map { index, phone in\n            ContactField(kind: .phone, label: phone.label, value: phone.value, sortIndex: index)\n        }\n        contact.fields = emails + phones\n        return contact\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Saving\n\n    private func saveOrRollback() throws {\n        do {\n            try context.save()\n        } catch {\n            context.rollback()\n            throw error\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

Data(contentsOf: url),\n                          let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else { return nil }\n                    return VCard.parse(text)\n                }.value\n\n                guard let parsed else {\n                    errorMessage = \"That file couldn't be read as a vCard.\"\n                    return\n                }\n                guard !parsed.isEmpty else {\n                    errorMessage = \"No contacts were found in that file.\"\n                    return\n                }\n\n                for card in parsed {\n                    context.insert(makeContact(from: card))\n                }\n                do {\n                    try context.save()\n                } catch {\n                    // Drop the just-inserted, unsaved contacts.\n                    context.rollback()\n                    errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func makeContact(from parsed: ParsedContact) -> Contact {\n        let contact = Contact(\n            firstName: parsed.firstName, lastName: parsed.lastName,\n            company: parsed.company, jobTitle: parsed.jobTitle,\n            street: parsed.street, city: parsed.city, state: parsed.state,\n            postalCode: parsed.postalCode, country: parsed.country,\n            birthday: parsed.birthday, notes: parsed.notes\n        )\n        var fields: [ContactField] = []\n        for (index, email) in parsed.emails.enumerated() {\n            fields.append(ContactField(kind: .email, label: email.label, value: email.value, sortIndex: index))\n        }\n        for (index, phone) in parsed.phones.enumerated() {\n            fields.append(ContactField(kind: .phone, label: phone.label, value: phone.value, sortIndex: index))\n        }\n        contact.fields = fields\n        return contact\n    }\n}",
