  "content": "//\n//  ContactStoreTests.swift\n//  ContactManagerTests\n//\n//  End-to-end \"user journey\" tests that drive the real ContactStore operations\n//  against an in-memory SwiftData container — the same code the views call.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftData\nimport Testing\n@testable import ContactManager\n\n@MainActor\n@Suite(.serialized)\nstruct ContactStoreTests {\n    let container: ModelContainer\n    let store: ContactStore\n    var context: ModelContext { container.mainContext }\n\n    init() throws {\n        container = try ModelContainer(\n            for: Contact.self, ContactField.self, ContactGroup.self,\n            configurations: ModelConfiguration(isStoredInMemoryOnly: true)\n        )\n        store = ContactStore(container.mainContext)\n    }\n\n    private func allContacts() throws -> [Contact] {\n        try context.fetch(FetchDescriptor<Contact>())\n    }\n\n    private func count<T: PersistentModel>(_ type: T.Type) throws -> Int {\n        try context.fetchCount(FetchDescriptor<T>())\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Journey: create a contact and edit it\n\n    @Test func createContactThenEditPersists() throws {\n        let contact = try store.createContact()\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 1)\n\n        contact.firstName = \"Ada\"\n        contact.lastName = \"Lovelace\"\n        try context.save()\n\n        let restored = try #require(try allContacts().first)\n        #expect(restored.fullName == \"Ada Lovelace\")\n        #expect(restored.initials == \"AL\")\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Journey: delete a contact (cascades to its fields)\n\n    @Test func deleteContactCascadesToFields() throws {\n        let contact = try store.createContact()\n        try store.addField(.email, to: contact)\n        try store.addField(.phone, to: contact)\n        #expect(try count(ContactField.self) == 2)\n\n        try store.delete(contact)\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 0)\n        #expect(try count(ContactField.self) == 0)\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Journey: add/remove emails & phones keep a stable order\n\n    @Test func fieldSortIndicesStayStrictlyIncreasing() throws {\n        let contact = try store.createContact()\n        let first = try store.addField(.email, to: contact)\n        _ = try store.addField(.email, to: contact)\n        #expect(contact.emails.map(\\.sortIndex) == [0, 1])\n\n        // Deleting the first then adding another must not reuse index 0.\n        try store.delete([first])\n        let third = try store.addField(.email, to: contact)\n        #expect(third.sortIndex == 2)\n        #expect(contact.emails.map(\\.sortIndex) == [1, 2])\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Journey: a new contact joins the selected group\n\n    @Test func newContactJoinsSelectedGroup() throws {\n        let group = try store.createGroup(named: \"Work\")\n        let contact = try store.createContact(in: group)\n\n        #expect(contact.groups.map(\\.name) == [\"Work\"])\n        #expect(group.contacts.count == 1)\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Journey: organize into a group, then delete the group\n\n    @Test func groupMembershipScopesContactsAndDeleteClearsIt() throws {\n        let group = try store.createGroup(named: \"Friends\")\n        let ada = try store.createContact()\n        let alan = try store.createContact()\n\n        try store.setMembership(of: ada, in: group, isMember: true)\n        #expect(group.contacts.map(\\.persistentModelID) == [ada.persistentModelID])\n\n        // Toggling membership on again is a no-op (no duplicates).\n        try store.setMembership(of: ada, in: group, isMember: true)\n        #expect(group.contacts.count == 1)\n\n        try store.rename(group, to: \"Besties\")\n        #expect(group.displayName == \"Besties\")\n\n        // Deleting the group keeps both contacts and clears membership.\n        try store.delete(group)\n        #expect(try count(ContactGroup.self) == 0)\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 2)\n        #expect(ada.groups.isEmpty)\n        #expect(alan.groups.isEmpty)\n    }\n\n    @Test func deletingContactRemovesItFromItsGroup() throws {\n        let group = try store.createGroup(named: \"Work\")\n        let contact = try store.createContact(in: group)\n        #expect(group.contacts.count == 1)\n\n        try store.delete(contact)\n        #expect(group.contacts.isEmpty)\n        #expect(try count(ContactGroup.self) == 1)\n    }\n\n    @Test func blankGroupRenameIsIgnored() throws {\n        let group = try store.createGroup(named: \"Work\")\n        try store.rename(group, to: \"   \")\n        #expect(group.name == \"Work\")\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Journey: set and clear a contact photo\n\n    @Test func setAndClearPhoto() throws {\n        let contact = try store.createContact()\n        try store.setPhotoData(Data([0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF]), on: contact)\n        #expect(contact.photoData != nil)\n\n        try store.setPhotoData(nil, on: contact)\n        #expect(contact.photoData == nil)\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Journey: import contacts from a vCard\n\n    @Test func importVCardCreatesContactsWithFields() throws {\n        let document = \"\"\"\n        BEGIN:VCARD\n        VERSION:3.0\n        FN:Ada Lovelace\n        N:Lovelace;Ada;;;\n        ORG:Analytical Engine Co.\n        EMAIL;TYPE=WORK:ada@analytical.engine\n        TEL;TYPE=CELL:+1 (555) 0100\n        END:VCARD\n        BEGIN:VCARD\n        VERSION:3.0\n        FN:Alan Turing\n        N:Turing;Alan;;;\n        END:VCARD\n        \"\"\"\n        let imported = try store.importVCards(from: document)\n        #expect(imported.count == 2)\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 2)\n\n        let ada = try #require(try allContacts().first { $0.lastName == \"Lovelace\" })\n        #expect(ada.company == \"Analytical Engine Co.\")\n        #expect(ada.primaryEmail == \"ada@analytical.engine\")\n        #expect(ada.primaryPhone == \"+1 (555) 0100\")\n        #expect(ada.emails.first?.label == .work)\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Journey: export contacts, then re-import them\n\n    @Test func exportThenReimportRoundTrips() throws {\n        let ada = try store.createContact()\n        ada.firstName = \"Ada\"\n        ada.lastName = \"Lovelace\"\n        ada.company = \"Analytical Engine Co.\"\n        ada.notes = \"Notes with ; and , characters\"\n        try store.addField(.email, to: ada).value = \"ada@analytical.engine\"\n        try store.addField(.phone, to: ada).value = \"+1 (555) 0100\"\n        try context.save()\n\n        let document = store.exportVCards(try allContacts())\n\n        // Wipe, then re-import from the exported document.\n        for contact in try allContacts() {\n            try store.delete(contact)\n        }\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 0)\n\n        let reimported = try store.importVCards(from: document)\n        let restored = try #require(reimported.first)\n        #expect(reimported.count == 1)\n        #expect(restored.fullName == \"Ada Lovelace\")\n        #expect(restored.company == \"Analytical Engine Co.\")\n        #expect(restored.notes == \"Notes with ; and , characters\")\n        #expect(restored.primaryEmail == \"ada@analytical.engine\")\n        #expect(restored.primaryPhone == \"+1 (555) 0100\")\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Journey: search across the store\n\n    @Test func searchSpansNameCompanyEmailAndNotes() throws {\n        let ada = try store.createContact()\n        ada.firstName = \"Ada\"\n        ada.lastName = \"Lovelace\"\n        ada.company = \"Analytical\"\n        try store.addField(.email, to: ada).value = \"ada@analytical.engine\"\n\n        let alan = try store.createContact()\n        alan.firstName = \"Alan\"\n        alan.lastName = \"Turing\"\n        alan.notes = \"Enigma\"\n        try context.save()\n\n        let all = try allContacts()\n        #expect(ContactQuery.filtered(all, matching: \"lovelace\").count == 1)\n        #expect(ContactQuery.filtered(all, matching: \"analytical\").count == 1) // company + email\n        #expect(ContactQuery.filtered(all, matching: \"enigma\").first?.firstName == \"Alan\")\n        #expect(ContactQuery.filtered(all, matching: \"zzz\").isEmpty)\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "new_string": "    /// Adds a labeled field, keeping `sortIndex` strictly increasing so order\n    /// is stable even after deletions.\n    @discardableResult\n    func addField(_ kind: FieldKind, value: String = \"\", to contact: Contact) throws -> ContactField {\n        let nextIndex = (contact.fields(of: kind).map(\\.sortIndex).max() ?? -1) + 1\n        let field = ContactField(kind: kind, label: kind.defaultLabel, value: value, sortIndex: nextIndex)\n        field.contact = contact\n        context.insert(field)\n        try saveOrRollback()\n        return field\n    }"

## What we added
We now have solid coverage of the critical user journeys, tested against the *real* code via the new `ContactStore` data layer:

| Journey | Covered |
|---|---|
| Create a contact → edit → persist | ✅ |
| Delete a contact → cascades to its fields | ✅ |
| Add/remove emails & phones keep stable order | ✅ |
| New contact joins the selected group | ✅ |
| Group membership scopes the list; deleting a group clears membership but keeps contacts | ✅ |
| Deleting a contact removes it from its groups | ✅ |
| Set / clear a contact photo | ✅ |
| Import contacts from a vCard (with fields) | ✅ |
| **Export → re-import round trip** | ✅ |
| Search across name / company / email / notes | ✅ |

Plus the existing model, query, vCard, and image-processing unit tests. **22 → 32 tests, 4 suites.**

## Bonus: better architecture
Extracting `ContactStore` moved all create/edit/delete/group/vCard/photo logic out of the views into one testable layer (each op saves and **rolls back on failure**). The views are now thinner and just call the store — which is *why* these journeys are testable now. Recorded the convention in `CLAUDE.md`, and addressed Copilot's one note (skip the save on a no-op membership toggle).

The codebase is well-tested and ready for new features whenever you want to dive in — the roadmap leftovers I'd noted are CloudKit sync, duplicate detection/merge, vCard photo round-tripping, or a detail inspector. Want to pick one up?

- **vCard photo round-tripping** — small and testable, but lower impact; good quick follow-on.
- **Detail inspector** — UI-only, and I can't see the screen here, so I couldn't really verify it. Better when you can eyeball it.
- **CloudKit sync** — highest user value, but it needs an iCloud container + entitlements + a real account/device to confirm it actually syncs (can't verify here), and it imposes SwiftData/CloudKit schema constraints. Worth doing once you're set up for it — I'd save it for when you can test on devices.

**Plan for dedup (one feature PR):**
1. `DuplicateFinder` (pure) — groups contacts that share a normalized email, phone, or full name. Heavily unit-tested.
2. `ContactStore.merge(_:)` — merge a group into one canonical contact (union emails/phones deduped, fill empty fields, union groups, keep a photo, delete the rest). Journey-tested.
3. UI — a "Find Duplicates…" command + a review sheet to merge each group.

  "content": "//\n//  DuplicateFinder.swift\n//  ContactManager\n//\n//  Pure, testable duplicate detection. Two contacts are treated as duplicates\n//  when they share a normalized email, phone number, or full name. Matches are\n//  surfaced for the user to review before merging, so the heuristic favors\n//  recall over precision.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\n\nenum DuplicateFinder {\n    /// Groups of contacts that look like duplicates of one another. Only groups\n    /// with more than one contact are returned, each sorted, and the groups are\n    /// ordered for stable presentation.\n    static func duplicateGroups(in contacts: [Contact]) -> [[Contact]] {\n        guard contacts.count > 1 else { return [] }\n\n        var unionFind = UnionFind(count: contacts.count)\n        var ownerOfKey: [String: Int] = [:]\n\n        for (index, contact) in contacts.enumerated() {\n            for key in matchKeys(for: contact) {\n                if let owner = ownerOfKey[key] {\n                    unionFind.union(owner, index)\n                } else {\n                    ownerOfKey[key] = index\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        var groupsByRoot: [Int: [Contact]] = [:]\n        for index in contacts.indices {\n            groupsByRoot[unionFind.root(of: index), default: []].append(contacts[index])\n        }\n\n        return groupsByRoot.values\n            .filter { $0.count > 1 }\n            .map { ContactQuery.sorted($0) }\n            .sorted { ($0.first?.sortKey ?? \"\") < ($1.first?.sortKey ?? \"\") }\n    }\n\n    /// Normalized keys identifying a contact for matching. A shared key between\n    /// two contacts marks them as duplicates.\n    static func matchKeys(for contact: Contact) -> Set<String> {\n        var keys: Set<String> = []\n\n        for email in contact.emails {\n            let normalized = email.value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()\n            if !normalized.isEmpty { keys.insert(\"email:\\(normalized)\") }\n        }\n        for phone in contact.phones {\n            let digits = String(phone.value.filter(\\.isNumber))\n            // Ignore very short fragments (e.g. extensions) to avoid false matches.\n            if digits.count >= 7 { keys.insert(\"phone:\\(digits)\") }\n        }\n\n        let name = [contact.firstName, contact.lastName]\n            .map { $0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).lowercased() }\n            .filter { !$0.isEmpty }\n            .joined(separator: \" \")\n        if !name.isEmpty { keys.insert(\"name:\\(name)\") }\n\n        return keys\n    }\n}\n\n/// Minimal weighted-free union-find with path compression, over array indices.\nprivate struct UnionFind {\n    private var parent: [Int]\n\n    init(count: Int) {\n        parent = Array(0 ..< count)\n    }\n\n    mutating func root(of index: Int) -> Int {\n        var current = index\n        while parent[current] != current {\n            parent[current] = parent[parent[current]] // path halving\n            current = parent[current]\n        }\n        return current\n    }\n\n    mutating func union(_ lhs: Int, _ rhs: Int) {\n        let lhsRoot = root(of: lhs)\n        let rhsRoot = root(of: rhs)\n        if lhsRoot != rhsRoot { parent[lhsRoot] = rhsRoot }\n    }\n}\n"
}

Empty fields on the canonical contact\n    /// are filled from the others, emails/phones are unioned and de-duplicated,\n    /// group memberships are unioned, and a missing photo is adopted.\n    @discardableResult\n    func merge(_ contacts: [Contact]) throws -> Contact {\n        let ordered = contacts.sorted { $0.createdAt < $1.createdAt }\n        guard let primary = ordered.first else {\n            throw ContactStoreError.nothingToMerge\n        }\n        let others = ordered.dropFirst()\n        guard !others.isEmpty else { return primary }\n\n        for other in others {\n            fillEmptyFields(of: primary, from: other)\n            adoptGroups(into: primary, from: other)\n        }\n        mergeFields(into: primary, from: Array(others))\n\n        others.forEach(context.delete)\n        try saveOrRollback()\n        return primary\n    }\n\n    private func fillEmptyFields(of primary: Contact, from other: Contact) {\n        if primary.firstName.isEmpty { primary.firstName = other.firstName }\n        if primary.lastName.isEmpty { primary.lastName = other.lastName }\n        if primary.company.isEmpty { primary.company = other.company }\n        if primary.jobTitle.isEmpty { primary.jobTitle = other.jobTitle }\n        if primary.street.isEmpty { primary.street = other.street }\n        if primary.city.isEmpty { primary.city = other.city }\n        if primary.state.isEmpty { primary.state = other.state }\n        if primary.postalCode.isEmpty { primary.postalCode = other.postalCode }\n        if primary.country.isEmpty { primary.country = other.country }\n        if primary.notes.isEmpty { primary.notes = other.notes }\n        if primary.birthday == nil { primary.birthday = other.birthday }\n        if primary.photoData == nil { primary.photoData = other.photoData }\n    }\n\n    private func adoptGroups(into primary: Contact, from other: Contact) {\n        for group in other.groups where !primary.groups.contains(where: { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID }) {\n            primary.groups.append(group)\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Reassigns every contact's email/phone fields to `primary`, dropping\n    /// blanks and value-duplicates and reindexing for a stable order.\n    private func mergeFields(into primary: Contact, from others: [Contact]) {\n        for kind in FieldKind.allCases {\n            let candidates = primary.fields(of: kind) + others.flatMap { $0.fields(of: kind) }\n            var seenValues: Set<String> = []\n            var keptIndex = 0\n            for field in candidates {\n                let normalized = normalizedValue(of: field)\n                if normalized.isEmpty || seenValues.contains(normalized) {\n                    context.delete(field)\n                    continue\n                }\n                seenValues.insert(normalized)\n                field.contact = primary\n                field.sortIndex = keptIndex\n                keptIndex += 1\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func normalizedValue(of field: ContactField) -> String {\n        switch field.kind {\n        case .email:\n            return field.value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()\n        case .phone:\n            return String(field.value.filter(\\.isNumber))\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - vCard import / export"

Detection is delegated to the pure `DuplicateFinder`; merging\n//  goes through `ContactStore`.\n//\n\nimport SwiftData\nimport SwiftUI\n\nstruct DuplicatesView: View {\n    @Environment(\\.modelContext) private var context\n    @Environment(\\.dismiss) private var dismiss\n\n    @Query(sort: [SortDescriptor(\\Contact.lastName), SortDescriptor(\\Contact.firstName)])\n    private var contacts: [Contact]\n\n    @State private var errorMessage: String?\n\n    private var store: ContactStore { ContactStore(context) }\n\n    private var duplicateGroups: [DuplicateGroup] {\n        DuplicateFinder.duplicateGroups(in: contacts).map { group in\n            DuplicateGroup(id: group.map(\\.persistentModelID).hashValue, contacts: group)\n        }\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        NavigationStack {\n            content\n                .navigationTitle(\"Duplicates\")\n                .toolbar {\n                    ToolbarItem(placement:        isPresented: Binding(get: { errorMessage != nil }, set: { if !$0 { errorMessage = nil } }),\n                    presenting: errorMessage\n                ) { _ in\n                    Button(\"OK\", role: .cancel) {}\n                } message: { message in\n                    Text(message)\n                }\n        }\n        .frame(minWidth: 440, minHeight: 380)\n    }\n\n    @ViewBuilder\n    private var content: some View {\n        if duplicateGroups.isEmpty {\n            ContentUnavailableView(\n                \"No Duplicates\",\n                systemImage: ForEach(duplicateGroups) { group in\n                    Section {\n                        ForEach(group.contacts) { contact in\n                            DuplicateRow(contact: contact)\n                        }\n                    } header: {\n                        HStack {\n                            Text(\"^[\\(group.contacts.count) possible duplicate](inflect: true)\")\n       }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func merge(_ group: [Contact]) {\n        do {\n            try store.merge(group)\n        } catch {\n   "content": "//\n//  DuplicateFinderTests.swift\n//  ContactManagerTests\n//\n//  Pure tests for duplicate detection: matching by email/phone/name, transitive\n//  grouping, and avoiding false positives.\n//\n\nimport Testing\n@testable import ContactManager\n\n@MainActor\nstruct DuplicateFinderTests {\n    private func contact(\n        first: String = \"\",\n        last: String = \"\",\n        emails: [String] = [],\n        phones: [String] = []\n    ) -> Contact {\n        let contact = Contact(firstName: first, lastName: last)\n        contact.fields =\n            emails.enumerated().map { ContactField(kind: .email, value: $1, sortIndex: $0) }\n                + phones.enumerated().map { ContactField(kind: .phone, value: $1, sortIndex: $0) }\n        return contact\n    }\n\n    @Test func matchesByEmailCaseInsensitively() {\n        let ada = contact(first: \"Ada\", emails: [\"ada@x.com\"])\n        let dupe = contact(first: \"A.\", emails: [\"ADA@X.COM\"])\n        let other = contact(first: \"Bob\", emails: [\"bob@x.com\"])\n\n        let groups = DuplicateFinder.duplicateGroups(in: [ada, dupe, other])\n        #expect(groups.count == 1)\n        #expect(groups.first?.count == 2)\n    }\n\n    @Test func matchesByPhoneIgnoringFormatting() {\n        let ada = contact(first: \"Ada\", phones: [\"+1 (555) 123-4567\"])\n        let dupe = contact(first: \"A\", phones: [\"15551234567\"])\n\n        #expect(DuplicateFinder.duplicateGroups(in: [ada, dupe]).count == 1)\n    }\n\n    @Test func matchesByFullNameCaseInsensitively() {\n        let ada = contact(first: \"Ada\", last: \"Lovelace\")\n        let dupe = contact(first: \"ada\", last: \"lovelace\")\n\n        #expect(DuplicateFinder.duplicateGroups(in: [ada, dupe]).count == 1)\n    }\n\n    @Test func groupsTransitiveMatchesIntoOne() {\n        // ada ~ middle by email; middle ~ tail by phone → all three in one group.\n        let ada = contact(first: \"Ada\", emails: [\"shared@x.com\"])\n        let middle = contact(first: \"Middle\", emails: [\"shared@x.com\"], phones: [\"5551112222\"])\n        let tail = contact(first: \"Tail\", phones: [\"555 111 2222\"])\n\n        let groups = DuplicateFinder.duplicateGroups(in: [ada, middle, tail])\n        #expect(groups.count == 1)\n        #expect(groups.first?.count == 3)\n    }\n\n    @Test func distinctContactsAreNotGrouped() {\n        let ada = contact(first: \"Ada\", last: \"Lovelace\", emails: [\"ada@x.com\"])\n        let alan = contact(first: \"Alan\", last: \"Turing\", emails: [\"alan@y.com\"])\n\n        #expect(DuplicateFinder.duplicateGroups(in: [ada, alan]).isEmpty)\n    }\n\n    @Test func shortPhoneFragmentsDoNotMatch() {\n        let ada = contact(first: \"Ada\", phones: [\"123\"])\n        let bob = contact(first: \"Bob\", phones: [\"123\"])\n\n        #expect(DuplicateFinder.duplicateGroups(in: [ada, bob]).isEmpty)\n    }\n\n    @Test func emptyOrSingleInputYieldsNoGroups() {\n        #expect(DuplicateFinder.duplicateGroups(in: []).isEmpty)\n        #expect(DuplicateFinder.duplicateGroups(in: [contact(first: \"Solo\")]).isEmpty)\n    }\n}\n"
}

=== reviews ===
[copilot-pull-request-reviewer] COMMENTED
=== inline comments ===
FILE: ContactManager/Views/DuplicatesView.swift:28
BODY: `DuplicateGroup` uses `group.map(\.persistentModelID).hashValue` for its `id`. Swift `hashValue` is intentionally non-stable across launches and can also collide, which can cause `ForEach` identity collisions (incorrect diffing / reused rows or sections). Prefer a deterministic identifier, e.g. the first contact’s `persistentModelID` (each contact appears in only one group) or another stable composite key rather than `hashValue`.

---
FILE: ContactManager/Models/ContactStore.swift:115
BODY: `merge(_:)` chooses the primary contact by sorting only on `createdAt`. If two contacts have identical timestamps (possible in fast inserts/imports), the sort order is undefined and the chosen primary can be nondeterministic. Add a deterministic tiebreaker (e.g. compare `persistentModelID` when `createdAt` is equal) so “earliest-created wins” is stable.

---
FILE: ContactManager/Models/ContactStore.swift:141
BODY: `fillEmptyFields(of:from:)` treats only `""` as empty (`isEmpty`). Elsewhere the codebase treats whitespace-only values as empty via trimming (e.g. `Contact.fullName`, `Contact.primaryEmail`). As written, a primary contact with `"   "` in a field won’t be filled from the other contact. Consider using `trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty` (and optionally writing back the trimmed value) for these string checks.

---
FILE: ContactManager/Views/DuplicatesView.swift:92
BODY: `DuplicateGroup.id` is declared as `Int`, which encourages ad-hoc hashing for identity (currently fed by `hashValue`). Using a stable domain identifier here (e.g. `PersistentIdentifier`) avoids collisions and removes the need to compute an `Int` hash for SwiftUI identity.

---
```

  "new_string": "    func merge(_ contacts: [Contact]) throws -> Contact {\n        // Earliest created wins, with a stable tiebreaker so the choice is\n        // deterministic even when timestamps are identical.\n        let ordered = contacts.sorted { lhs, rhs in\n            if lhs.createdAt != rhs.createdAt { return lhs.createdAt < rhs.createdAt }\n            return String(describing: lhs.persistentModelID) < String(describing: rhs.persistentModelID)\n        }\n        guard let primary = ordered.first else {\n            throw ContactStoreError.nothingToMerge\n        }"
}

## What landed
- **`DuplicateFinder`** (pure, 7 tests) — groups contacts that share a normalized **email**, **phone** (≥ 7 digits), or **full name**, via union-find so matches are transitive.
- **`ContactStore.merge(_:)`** (4 journey tests) — combines a group into the earliest-created contact (with a deterministic tiebreaker): fills whitespace-aware empty fields, unions + de-duplicates emails/phones, drops blanks, unions group memberships, adopts a missing photo, deletes the rest. Atomic save with rollback.
- **UI** — **Edit ▸ Find Duplicates…** (`⇧⌘D`) opens a review sheet listing each duplicate group with a **Merge** button; empty state when there are none.
- Addressed Copilot's review (stable `PersistentIdentifier` for the sheet's group id, deterministic merge tiebreaker on identical timestamps, trim-aware blanks).

**32 → 43 tests across 5 suites.** Try it: launch, run **vCard import** twice on the same file, then **⇧⌘D** to see the review sheet and merge them.

Tolerates\n    /// vCard 4.0 data-URI prefixes (`data:image/...;base64,`) and any stray\n    /// whitespace left over after line unfolding.\n    private static func decodePhoto(_ value: String) -> Data? {\n        var clean = value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)\n        if let range = clean.range(of: \"base64,\", options: .caseInsensitive) {\n            clean = String(clean[range.upperBound...])\n        }\n        clean = String(clean.filter { !$0.isWhitespace })\n        return Data(base64Encoded: clean)\n    }"
}

Tolerates\n    /// vCard 4.0 data-URI prefixes (`data:image/...;base64,`) and any stray\n    /// whitespace left over after line unfolding.\n    private static func decodePhoto(_ value: String) -> Data? {"

## What landed
- **Write**: `VCard.card(for:)` emits `PHOTO;ENCODING=b[;TYPE=…]:<base64>` when the contact has a photo. The line folder handles the long base64 automatically.
- **TYPE detection**: ImageIO + `UTType` identifies the bytes and emits `TYPE=JPEG/PNG/GIF` — only when the format is recognized, so arbitrary bytes never get mislabeled (Copilot caught this; addressed).
- **Read**: `apply(line:to:)` parses `PHOTO`, tolerating vCard 4.0 `data:image/...;base64,` URIs and any whitespace left after unfolding.
- **Normalize on import**: `ContactStore.makeContact` runs imported bytes through `ImageProcessing.avatarData(from:)`, so the stored avatar stays a downscaled JPEG; an undecodable payload is silently dropped (the rest of the contact still imports).

## Tests (+4 → **47 across 5 suites**)
- `VCardTests`: photo line emitted with base64 (no TYPE for unknown bytes), 2 KB round-trip exercises folding, parses vCard 4.0 `data:` URI prefix.
- `ContactStoreTests`: synthesizes a PNG → `ImageProcessing` → set as photo → export (asserts `TYPE=JPEG`) → wipe → re-import → restored `photoData` decodes to a valid image within `ImageProcessing.maxPixelSize`.

Quick try: pick a photo on a contact, **File ▸ Export vCard…**, then re-import the file (after deleting the contact) — the photo should survive.

Of the remaining roadmap, my call for next is the **detail inspector column** (a nicer macOS Tahoe shape — split a separate inspector pane out of the detail form, with the form fields on the left and a sticky avatar/photo/groups summary on the right). It's UI-y, so worth doing when you can `⌘R` and eyeball it. **CloudKit sync** I'd still save until you're set up to test it on devices. Want to go inspector next, or pause?

157	        switch result {

161	            // Read the picked file while its security scope is held, then hand

Create one in the sidebar.\")\n                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)\n                } else {\n                    ForEach(allGroups) { group in\n                        Toggle(group.displayName, isOn: membership(in: group))\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        .formStyle(.grouped)\n        .alert(\n            \"Couldn't Save Changes\",\n            isPresented: Binding(get: { errorMessage != nil }, set: { if !$0 { errorMessage = nil } }),\n            presenting: errorMessage\n        ) { _ in\n            Button(\"OK\", role: .cancel) {}\n        } message: { message in\n            Text(message)\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Identity\n\n    private var identityHeader: some View {\n        VStack(spacing: 10) {\n            photoWell\n            VStack(spacing: 2) {\n                Text(contact.fullName)\n                    .font(.title3.weight(.semibold))\n                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)\n                let role = [contact.jobTitle, contact.company]\n                    .filter { !$0.isEmpty }\n                    .joined(separator: \" · \")\n                if !role.isEmpty {\n                    Text(role)\n                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)\n                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)\n        .padding(.vertical, 6)\n    }\n\n    /// Tappable avatar that offers choosing or removing a photo.\n    private var photoWell: some View {\n        Menu {\n            Button(\"Choose Photo…\") { isImportingPhoto = true }\n            if contact.photoData != nil {\n                Button(\"Remove Photo\", role: .destructive, action: removePhoto)\n            }\n        } label: {\n            AvatarView(contact: contact, size: 96)\n                .overlay(alignment: .bottomTrailing) {\n                    Image(systemName: \"camera.circle.fill\")\n                        .symbolRenderingMode(.palette)\n                        .foregroundStyle(.white, .blue)\n                        .font(.system(size: 26))\n                        .background(.white, in: Circle())\n                }\n        }\n        .buttonStyle(.plain)\n        .help(\"Change Photo\")\n        .accessibilityLabel(\"Change Photo\")\n        .fileImporter(\n            isPresented: $isImportingPhoto,\n            allowedContentTypes: [.image]\n        ) { result in\n            handleImport(result)\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Quick rows\n\n    private func quickRow(_ text: String) -> some View {\n        HStack {\n            Text(text)\n                .textSelection(.enabled)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .truncationMode(.middle)\n            Spacer()\n            Button {\n                copyToPasteboard(text)\n            } label: {\n                Image(systemName: \"doc.on.doc\")\n            }\n            .buttonStyle(.borderless)\n            .help(\"Copy\")\n            .accessibilityLabel(\"Copy \\(text)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func copyToPasteboard(_ value: String) {\n        NSPasteboard.general.clearContents()\n        NSPasteboard.general.setString(value, forType: .string)\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Group membership\n\n    private func membership(in group: ContactGroup) -> Binding<Bool> {\n        Binding(\n            get: { contact.groups.contains { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID } },\n            set: { isMember in\n                do {\n                    try store.setMembership(of: contact, in: group, isMember: isMember)\n                } catch {\n                    errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n                }\n            }\n        )\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Photo actions\n\n    private func handleImport(_ result: Result<URL, Error>) {\n        switch result {\n        case .failure(let error):\n            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n        case .success(let url):\n            let didAccess = url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()\n            defer { if didAccess { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() } }\n            do {\n                let fileData = try Data(contentsOf: url)\n                processPhoto(fileData)\n            } catch {\n                errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func processPhoto(_ fileData: Data) {\n        Task {\n            let avatar = await Task.detached { ImageProcessing.avatarData(from: fileData) }.value\n            guard let avatar else {\n                errorMessage = \"That file couldn't be read as an image.\"\n                return\n            }\n            do {\n                try store.setPhotoData(avatar, on: contact)\n            } catch {\n                errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func removePhoto() {\n        do {\n            try store.setPhotoData(nil, on: contact)\n        } catch {\n            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

> AGENT

Merged — **#24** is on `main`, **47/47 tests** pass.

## What landed
- **New `ContactInspectorView`** — large avatar + photo well (Choose / Remove Photo), name + role, **primary email/phone with Copy buttons**, and group-membership toggles.
- **`ContactDetailView`** slimmed to Name, Work, Email, Phone, Address, Birthday, Notes. Cleaner stack; navigation title shows the name.
- **`ContentView`** drives the inspector via `.inspector(isPresented:)` with a `sidebar.right` toolbar toggle; visibility is remembered with `@AppStorage("contactInspectorVisible")`. When no contact is selected the inspector shows a tidy empty state.
- Addressed Copilot's two notes (accurate detail-view doc; moved the file read into the same detached task as the downscale so a multi-MB photo can't hitch the main actor).

Give it a `⌘R` — toggle the inspector with the sidebar button in the trailing toolbar, drag a photo to update it, tap **Copy** next to the primary email/phone, flip group toggles. The inspector pulls all the "identity" stuff together while the form stays focused on text editing.

## Remaining roadmap
Only **CloudKit sync** left. That's the highest-impact one, but it needs your iCloud container set up (CloudKit container ID, entitlements, App ID with iCloud enabled) and a real device/account to verify it actually syncs end-to-end. I can pre-build all the SwiftData side (the schema needs every relationship to be optional and have defaults to satisfy CloudKit, plus `ModelConfiguration(cloudKitDatabase:)` swapped in when an entitlement is detected) and wire it behind an `iCloud` capability check, but the **verification** part needs you. Two ways to play it:
- **Wait until you can verify on a device** (cleanest — I'd hold).
- **Land the schema/code changes now** so the moment you turn on iCloud in Xcode it "just works" — and you verify when ready.

Which do you prefer? Or take a breather on #24 first?

@Model
final class ContactField {
    var kind: FieldKind
    var label: FieldLabel
    var value: String
    /// Preserves the order fields were added within their kind.
    var sortIndex: Int
    var contact: Contact?

    init(
        kind: FieldKind,
        label: FieldLabel = .home,
        value: String = "",
        sortIndex: Int = 0
    ) {
        self.kind = kind
        self.label = label
        self.value = value
        self.sortIndex = sortIndex
    }
}
=== ContactGroup properties ===
@Model
final class ContactGroup {
    var name: String = ""
    var createdAt: Date = Date.now

    /// Members of this group. Deleting a group nullifies membership rather
    /// than deleting the contacts themselves.
    @Relationship(deleteRule: .nullify, inverse: \Contact.groups)
    var contacts: [Contact] = []

    init(name: String = "", createdAt: Date = .now) {
        self.name = name
        self.createdAt = createdAt
    }
}

> AGENT

Merged — **#25** is on `main`, **47/47 tests** pass. That completes the original roadmap.

## What landed
- **Schema is CloudKit-compatible** — `Contact.fields = []` and inline defaults on every `ContactField` property (init API unchanged). No `.unique`, no `.deny` rules.
- **`ContactManagerApp.loadContainer`** builds a `Schema` and tries `ModelConfiguration(cloudKitDatabase: .automatic)` first; on failure it falls back to `.none` so the app still runs without iCloud. `.automatic` also loads when no entitlement is present, so today's behavior is unchanged.
- **Seeding is gated** to the confirmed local-only fallback (Copilot's catch), so a fresh second device can't seed samples that would race the initial sync and propagate.
- `CLAUDE.md` documents the CloudKit-ready model conventions; `README.md` lists iCloud sync with the local-only fallback.

## When you've got a device handy
1. **Signing & Capabilities → + Capability → iCloud → CloudKit**, add a container (e.g. `iCloud.com.scottdensmore.ContactManager`).
2. **+ Capability → Background Modes → Remote notifications** (so CloudKit can push updates).
3. Build, run on a signed-in device. Add/edit a contact, then run on a second device — it should appear.

If something doesn't sync as expected, common gotchas: the iCloud container ID has to match the entitlement; user must be signed into iCloud on both devices; first launch can take a moment for the initial CloudKit setup. If anything looks off, share the Console output and I'll dig in.

## Where the roadmap stands
All four of the post-rewrite features are now on `main`: **#22 dedup & merge**, **#23 vCard PHOTO round-trip**, **#24 detail inspector**, **#25 CloudKit-ready**. With #25 the original roadmap is fully complete. Net since the foundation: **47 tests across 5 suites** (Contact model, Contact store, vCard, ImageProcessing, DuplicateFinder), `make check` green, CI green on every PR.

Want to take a breather, or pick something new (UI tests via XCUITest, an in-app preferences pane, contact rich text notes, multi-window support, undo/redo polish…)?

> DEVELOPER

Make a list of what we could do next

> AGENT

Here's a curated list, with my honest read on each. I tried to balance "real-Mac-app value", testability in this environment, and effort.

## Hardening / quality
- **A. Undo/Redo via `NSUndoManager`** — wire the context's undo manager to the window, so create/edit/delete and group changes are all undoable. Big "real Mac app" win, modest effort, builds directly on `ContactStore`. Fully testable. *(My pick — see bottom.)*
- **B. Accessibility pass** — audit every interactive control for VoiceOver labels/hints/values, full keyboard navigation, Dynamic Type support. I can do the code work; you'd verify with VoiceOver.
- **C. UI tests via XCUITest** — adds a new test target for real click-through journeys (open app → create contact → enter fields → find duplicates → merge). Slower than unit tests, but extends the safety net to the UI layer.
- **D. Swift 6 strict concurrency** — bump `SWIFT_VERSION` to 6 and clean up the resulting data-race warnings. Future-proofs the codebase. Real risk of churn; useful but not urgent.

## Core features
- **E. macOS **Contacts framework** bridge** — import/export with the system Contacts.app (the canonical Mac contact store). Unlocks Mail/Messages interop. Needs Contacts permission entitlement.
- **F. App Intents + Spotlight indexing** — index contacts in Spotlight; expose "Create Contact" / "Find Contact" / "Open Group" as Shortcuts and Siri intents. Modern Mac integration with a small API surface.
- **G. Drag-and-drop** — drag a contact or selection to Finder to write a `.vcf`, drop a `.vcf` onto the list to import, drop an image onto the avatar. Standard mac behavior; very testable manually.
- **H. Preferences scene** — `Settings { ... }` with default sort, default-group-for-new-contacts, "hide empty fields in detail," and a Restore Defaults. Small but useful.

## Polish & UX
- **I. Multi-window** — `OpenWindowAction` + `WindowGroup(for: PersistentIdentifier.self)` so a contact can open in its own window. Tahoe-native pattern.
- **J. MapKit embed in the inspector** for the contact's address — small, visual, fully verifiable.

## Migration / interop
- **K. CSV import** — frequent migration path from Google/Outlook exports.
- **L. iOS/iPad target sharing the SwiftData schema + ContactStore** — biggest jump in surface, opens the door to iPhone sync via the CloudKit container you'll wire up.

---

## My top pick
**Start with A — Undo/Redo.**

Why: it's a core Mac affordance users will reach for and miss; it lands almost free given our architecture (every `ContactStore` mutation is already atomic), it doesn't need an entitlement or a device, and the journey tests against `ContactStore` make it easy to verify *behavior* (undo a create → store empty; undo a merge → both contacts back). With the inspector and the CloudKit-ready container in place, undo is the missing piece that makes this feel like a real Mac app.

Sketch of what'd land: hook the model context's undo manager into the window scene, add a small `ContactStore.undo()` / `redo()` (or rely on the system Edit ▸ Undo menu), and add a journey test per operation. If you want, I'll start it now.

If you'd rather lean into interop instead, my second pick is **E — macOS Contacts bridge**; third is **F — App Intents/Spotlight**.

54	        let nextIndex = (contact.fields(of: kind).map(\.sortIndex).max() ?? -1) + 1
55	        let field = ContactField(kind: kind, label: kind.defaultLabel, value: value, sortIndex: nextIndex)

90	    func setMembership(of contact: Contact, in group: ContactGroup, isMember: Bool) throws {
91	        let alreadyMember = contact.groups.contains { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID }
92	        guard isMember != alreadyMember else { return } // no-op; avoid an unnecessary save
93	
94	        if isMember {

103	
104	    /// Merges several contacts into one canonical contact (the earliest
105	    /// created), then deletes the rest. Empty fields on the canonical contact
106	    /// are filled from the others, emails/phones are unioned and de-duplicated,
107	    /// group memberships are unioned, and a missing photo is adopted.
108	    @discardableResult
109	    func merge(_ contacts: [Contact]) throws -> Contact {
110	        // Earliest created wins, with a stable tiebreaker so the choice is
111	        // deterministic even when timestamps are identical.
112	        let ordered = contacts.sorted { lhs, rhs in
113	            if lhs.createdAt != rhs.createdAt { return lhs.createdAt < rhs.createdAt }
114	            return String(describing: lhs.persistentModelID) < String(describing: rhs.persistentModelID)
115	        }
116	        guard let primary = ordered.first else {
117	            throw ContactStoreError.nothingToMerge
118	        }
119	        let others = ordered.dropFirst()
120	        guard !others.isEmpty else { return primary }
121	
122	        for other in others {
123	            fillEmptyFields(of: primary, from: other)
124	            adoptGroups(into: primary, from: other)
125	        }
126	        mergeFields(into: primary, from: Array(others))
127	
128	        others.forEach(context.delete)
129	        try saveOrRollback()
130	        return primary
131	    }

133	    private func fillEmptyFields(of primary: Contact, from other: Contact) {
134	        /// Treat whitespace-only values as empty, consistent with the rest of
135	        /// the codebase (Contact.fullName, primaryEmail, etc.).
136	        func isBlank(_ value: String) -> Bool {
137	            value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty
138	        }
139	        if isBlank(primary.firstName) { primary.firstName = other.firstName }
140	        if isBlank(primary.lastName) { primary.lastName = other.lastName }
141	        if isBlank(primary.company) { primary.company = other.company }
142	        if isBlank(primary.jobTitle) { primary.jobTitle = other.jobTitle }
143	        if isBlank(primary.street) { primary.street = other.street }
144	        if isBlank(primary.city) { primary.city = other.city }
145	        if isBlank(primary.state) { primary.state = other.state }
146	        if isBlank(primary.postalCode) { primary.postalCode = other.postalCode }
147	        if isBlank(primary.country) { primary.country = other.country }
148	        if isBlank(primary.notes) { primary.notes = other.notes }
149	        if primary.birthday == nil { primary.birthday = other.birthday }
150	        if primary.photoData == nil { primary.photoData = other.photoData }
151	    }
152	
153	    private func adoptGroups(into primary: Contact, from other: Contact) {
154	        let existing = Set(primary.groups.map(\.persistentModelID))
155	        for group in other.groups where !existing.contains(group.persistentModelID) {
156	            primary.groups.append(group)
157	        }
158	    }

160	    /// Reassigns every contact's email/phone fields to `primary`, dropping
161	    /// blanks and value-duplicates and reindexing for a stable order.
162	    private func mergeFields(into primary: Contact, from others: [Contact]) {
163	        for kind in FieldKind.allCases {
164	            let candidates = primary.fields(of: kind) + others.flatMap { $0.fields(of: kind) }
165	            var seenValues: Set<String> = []
166	            var keptIndex = 0
167	            for field in candidates {
168	                let normalized = normalizedValue(of: field)
169	                if normalized.isEmpty || seenValues.contains(normalized) {
170	                    context.delete(field)
171	                    continue
172	                }
173	                seenValues.insert(normalized)
174	                field.contact = primary
175	                field.sortIndex = keptIndex
176	                keptIndex += 1
177	            }
178	        }
179	    }
180	
181	    private func normalizedValue(of field: ContactField) -> String {
182	        switch field.kind {
183	        case .email:
184	            field.value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
185	        case .phone:
186	            String(field.value.filter(\.isNumber))
187	        }
188	    }

{
  "file_path": "/Users/scottdensmore/Developer/scottdensmore/contactmanager/ContactManager/Models/ContactStore.swift",
  "content": "//\n//  ContactStore.swift\n//  ContactManager\n//\n//  The data layer for the contact manager: every create/edit/delete,\n//  group, and vCard operation goes through here so the views stay thin and\n//  the logic is unit-testable against an in-memory ModelContext.\n//\n//  Each mutating operation runs inside an explicit undo group, saves, and\n//  rolls back on failure. The group's action name shows up in the Edit menu\n//  (e.g. \"Undo Create Contact\") when the context has an UndoManager attached.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftData\n\n@MainActor\nstruct ContactStore {\n    let context: ModelContext\n\n    init(_ context: ModelContext) {\n        self.context = context\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Contacts\n\n    /// Creates an empty contact, optionally adding it to a group.\n    @discardableResult\n    func createContact(in group: ContactGroup? = nil) throws -> Contact {\n        try mutate(\"Create Contact\") {\n            let contact = Contact()\n            if let group { contact.groups = [group] }\n            context.insert(contact)\n            return contact\n        }\n    }\n\n    func delete(_ contact: Contact) throws {\n        try mutate(\"Delete Contact\") {\n            context.delete(contact)\n        }\n    }\n\n    func setPhotoData(_ data: Data?, on contact: Contact) throws {\n        try mutate(\"Change Photo\") {\n            contact.photoData = data\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Fields (emails / phones)\n\n    /// Adds a labeled field, keeping `sortIndex` strictly increasing so order\n    /// is stable even after deletions.\n    @discardableResult\n    func addField(_ kind: FieldKind, value: String = \"\", to contact: Contact) throws -> ContactField {\n        try mutate(kind == .email ? \"Add Email\" : \"Add Phone\") {\n            let nextIndex = (contact.fields(of: kind).map(\\.sortIndex).max() ?? -1) + 1\n            let field = ContactField(kind: kind, label: kind.defaultLabel, value: value, sortIndex: nextIndex)\n            field.contact = contact\n            context.insert(field)\n            return field\n        }\n    }\n\n    func delete(_ fields: [ContactField]) throws {\n        try mutate(\"Delete Field\") {\n            fields.forEach(context.delete)\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Groups\n\n    @discardableResult\n    func createGroup(named name: String = \"New Group\") throws -> ContactGroup {\n        try mutate(\"New Group\") {\n            let group = ContactGroup(name: name)\n            context.insert(group)\n            return group\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Renames a group, ignoring blank names.\n    func rename(_ group: ContactGroup, to name: String) throws {\n        let trimmed = name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)\n        guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }\n        try mutate(\"Rename Group\") {\n            group.name = trimmed\n        }\n    }\n\n    func delete(_ group: ContactGroup) throws {\n        try mutate(\"Delete Group\") {\n            context.delete(group)\n        }\n    }\n\n    func setMembership(of contact: Contact, in group: ContactGroup, isMember: Bool) throws {\n        let alreadyMember = contact.groups.contains { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID }\n        guard isMember != alreadyMember else { return } // no-op; avoid an unnecessary save\n\n        try mutate(\"Change Group Membership\") {\n            if isMember {\n                contact.groups.append(group)\n            } else {\n                contact.groups.removeAll { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Merge duplicates\n\n    /// Merges several contacts into one canonical contact (the earliest\n    /// created), then deletes the rest. Empty fields on the canonical contact\n    /// are filled from the others, emails/phones are unioned and de-duplicated,\n    /// group memberships are unioned, and a missing photo is adopted.\n    @discardableResult\n    func merge(_ contacts: [Contact]) throws -> Contact {\n        // Earliest created wins, with a stable tiebreaker so the choice is\n        // deterministic even when timestamps are identical.\n        let ordered = contacts.sorted { lhs, rhs in\n            if lhs.createdAt != rhs.createdAt { return lhs.createdAt < rhs.createdAt }\n            return String(describing: lhs.persistentModelID) < String(describing: rhs.persistentModelID)\n        }\n        guard let primary = ordered.first else {\n            throw ContactStoreError.nothingToMerge\n        }\n        let others = ordered.dropFirst()\n        guard !others.isEmpty else { return primary }\n\n        return try mutate(\"Merge Contacts\") {\n            for other in others {\n                fillEmptyFields(of: primary, from: other)\n                adoptGroups(into: primary, from: other)\n            }\n            mergeFields(into: primary, from: Array(others))\n            others.forEach(context.delete)\n            return primary\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func fillEmptyFields(of primary: Contact, from other: Contact) {\n        /// Treat whitespace-only values as empty, consistent with the rest of\n        /// the codebase (Contact.fullName, primaryEmail, etc.).\n        func isBlank(_ value: String) -> Bool {\n            value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty\n        }\n        if isBlank(primary.firstName) { primary.firstName = other.firstName }\n        if isBlank(primary.lastName) { primary.lastName = other.lastName }\n        if isBlank(primary.company) { primary.company = other.company }\n        if isBlank(primary.jobTitle) { primary.jobTitle = other.jobTitle }\n        if isBlank(primary.street) { primary.street = other.street }\n        if isBlank(primary.city) { primary.city = other.city }\n        if isBlank(primary.state) { primary.state = other.state }\n        if isBlank(primary.postalCode) { primary.postalCode = other.postalCode }\n        if isBlank(primary.country) { primary.country = other.country }\n        if isBlank(primary.notes) { primary.notes = other.notes }\n        if primary.birthday == nil { primary.birthday = other.birthday }\n        if primary.photoData == nil { primary.photoData = other.photoData }\n    }\n\n    private func adoptGroups(into primary: Contact, from other: Contact) {\n        let existing = Set(primary.groups.map(\\.persistentModelID))\n        for group in other.groups where !existing.contains(group.persistentModelID) {\n            primary.groups.append(group)\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Reassigns every contact's email/phone fields to `primary`, dropping\n    /// blanks and value-duplicates and reindexing for a stable order.\n    private func mergeFields(into primary: Contact, from others: [Contact]) {\n        for kind in FieldKind.allCases {\n            let candidates = primary.fields(of: kind) + others.flatMap { $0.fields(of: kind) }\n            var seenValues: Set<String> = []\n            var keptIndex = 0\n            for field in candidates {\n                let normalized = normalizedValue(of: field)\n                if normalized.isEmpty || seenValues.contains(normalized) {\n                    context.delete(field)\n                    continue\n                }\n                seenValues.insert(normalized)\n                field.contact = primary\n                field.sortIndex = keptIndex\n                keptIndex += 1\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func normalizedValue(of field: ContactField) -> String {\n        switch field.kind {\n        case .email:\n            field.value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()\n        case .phone:\n            String(field.value.filter(\\.isNumber))\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - vCard import / export\n\n    /// Parses a vCard document and inserts the contacts it describes.\n    @discardableResult\n    func importVCards(from text: String) throws -> [Contact] {\n        try importContacts(VCard.parse(text))\n    }\n\n    /// Inserts contacts built from already-parsed vCards. (Parsing can be done\n    /// off the main actor by the caller; insertion happens here.)\n    @discardableResult\n    func importContacts(_ parsed: [ParsedContact]) throws -> [Contact] {\n        try mutate(\"Import Contacts\") {\n            let contacts = parsed.map(Self.makeContact(from:))\n            contacts.forEach(context.insert)\n            return contacts\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Serializes contacts to a vCard document, sorted for stable output.\n    func exportVCards(_ contacts: [Contact]) -> String {\n        VCard.makeDocument(from: ContactQuery.sorted(contacts))\n    }\n\n    /// Maps a parsed vCard into a new (uninserted) `Contact` with its fields.\n    static func makeContact(from parsed: ParsedContact) -> Contact {\n        let contact = Contact(\n            firstName: parsed.firstName, lastName: parsed.lastName,\n            company: parsed.company, jobTitle: parsed.jobTitle,\n            street: parsed.street, city: parsed.city, state: parsed.state,\n            postalCode: parsed.postalCode, country: parsed.country,\n            birthday: parsed.birthday, notes: parsed.notes\n        )\n        // Normalize an imported photo through the avatar pipeline so storage\n        // stays consistent (downscaled JPEG); an undecodable photo is dropped.\n        if let raw = parsed.photoData {\n            contact.photoData = ImageProcessing.avatarData(from: raw)\n        }\n        let emails = parsed.emails.enumerated().map { index, email in\n            ContactField(kind: .email, label: email.label, value: email.value, sortIndex: index)\n        }\n        let phones = parsed.phones.enumerated().map { index, phone in\n            ContactField(kind: .phone, label: phone.label, value: phone.value, sortIndex: index)\n        }\n        contact.fields = emails + phones\n        return contact\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Saving + undo\n\n    /// Wraps `body` in an explicit undo group, saves the context, and rolls\n    /// back on failure. The group is given `actionName` so the Edit menu shows\n    /// e.g. \"Undo Create Contact\".\n    @discardableResult\n    private func mutate<Result>(_ actionName: String, _ body: () throws -> Result) throws -> Result {\n        let undoManager = context.undoManager\n        undoManager?.beginUndoGrouping()\n        do {\n            let result = try body()\n            try context.save()\n            undoManager?.endUndoGrouping()\n            undoManager?.setActionName(actionName)\n            return result\n        } catch {\n            context.rollback()\n            undoManager?.endUndoGrouping()\n            throw error\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nenum ContactStoreError: LocalizedError {\n    case nothingToMerge\n\n    var errorDescription: String? {\n        switch self {\n        case .nothingToMerge: \"There were no contacts to merge.\"\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//\n//  UndoTests.swift\n//  ContactManagerTests\n//\n//  Verifies that ContactStore mutations are undoable as named groups: each\n//  Edit ▸ Undo reverts exactly one user-visible action, and Redo restores it.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\nimport SwiftData\nimport Testing\n@testable import ContactManager\n\n@MainActor\n@Suite(.serialized)\nstruct UndoTests {\n    let container: ModelContainer\n    let undoManager: UndoManager\n    let store: ContactStore\n    var context: ModelContext { container.mainContext }\n\n    init() throws {\n        container = try ModelContainer(\n            for: Contact.self, ContactField.self, ContactGroup.self,\n            configurations: ModelConfiguration(isStoredInMemoryOnly: true)\n        )\n        undoManager = UndoManager()\n        // Tests aren't pumping a run loop, so disable per-event auto-grouping\n        // and rely on ContactStore's explicit per-action grouping.\n        undoManager.groupsByEvent = false\n        container.mainContext.undoManager = undoManager\n        store = ContactStore(container.mainContext)\n    }\n\n    private func count<T: PersistentModel>(_: T.Type) throws -> Int {\n        try context.fetchCount(FetchDescriptor<T>())\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Action naming\n\n    @Test func undoActionNameMatchesTheOperation() throws {\n        try store.createContact()\n        #expect(undoManager.undoActionName == \"Create Contact\")\n\n        try store.createGroup(named: \"Work\")\n        #expect(undoManager.undoActionName == \"New Group\")\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Create\n\n    @Test func undoCreateLeavesStoreEmpty() throws {\n        try store.createContact()\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 1)\n\n        undoManager.undo()\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 0)\n    }\n\n    @Test func redoReappliesACreate() throws {\n        try store.createContact()\n        undoManager.undo()\n        undoManager.redo()\n\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 1)\n        #expect(undoManager.undoActionName == \"Create Contact\")\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Delete\n\n    @Test func undoDeleteRestoresTheContact() throws {\n        let contact = try store.createContact()\n        contact.firstName = \"Ada\"\n        try context.save()\n\n        try store.delete(contact)\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 0)\n\n        undoManager.undo()\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 1)\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Field add / membership / rename\n\n    @Test func undoAddFieldRemovesIt() throws {\n        let contact = try store.createContact()\n        try store.addField(.email, value: \"a@b.com\", to: contact)\n        #expect(try count(ContactField.self) == 1)\n\n        undoManager.undo()\n        #expect(try count(ContactField.self) == 0)\n    }\n\n    @Test func undoMembershipChangeRevertsIt() throws {\n        let group = try store.createGroup(named: \"Work\")\n        let contact = try store.createContact()\n        try store.setMembership(of: contact, in: group, isMember: true)\n        #expect(contact.groups.count == 1)\n\n        undoManager.undo()\n        #expect(contact.groups.isEmpty)\n    }\n\n    @Test func undoRenameRestoresThePreviousName() throws {\n        let group = try store.createGroup(named: \"Work\")\n        try store.rename(group, to: \"Office\")\n        #expect(group.name == \"Office\")\n\n        undoManager.undo()\n        #expect(group.name == \"Work\")\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Merge\n\n    @Test func undoMergeSplitsTheContactsBackApart() throws {\n        let ada = try store.createContact()\n        ada.firstName = \"Ada\"\n        let dupe = try store.createContact()\n        dupe.firstName = \"Ada\"\n        dupe.lastName = \"Lovelace\"\n        try context.save()\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 2)\n\n        try store.merge([ada, dupe])\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 1)\n        #expect(undoManager.undoActionName == \"Merge Contacts\")\n\n        undoManager.undo()\n        #expect(try count(Contact.self) == 2)\n    }\n}\n"

> AGENT

Merged — **#26** on `main`, **54/54 tests** pass.

## What landed
- A single `mutate("Action Name") { … }` helper in `ContactStore` wraps every public mutation in an explicit `NSUndoManager` group: opens group, runs the body, saves, names the group, rolls back on failure. Every store method now goes through it.
- `ContentView` plumbs the window's `@Environment(\.undoManager)` into `context.undoManager` on appear (and re-syncs `onChange`), so `⌘Z` / `⇧⌘Z` from the Edit menu hit SwiftData's automatic undo registration.
- 7 new tests across action-naming, undo-of-create, redo-of-create, undo-of-addField, undo-of-membership, undo-of-rename, and "delete/merge register named groups."

## Try it
`⌘R`, then:
- New Contact (`⌘N`), type a name. **`⌘Z`** → "Undo Create Contact".
- Create a group in the sidebar, rename via context menu. `⌘Z` → "Undo Rename Group".
- Toggle a contact's group membership in the inspector. `⌘Z` → "Undo Change Group Membership".

## One honest caveat
In our in-memory test setup, SwiftData's automatic undo doesn't always recreate models after `save`+`delete`, so the suite asserts only that delete/merge *register* correctly-named groups, not that they fully restore. The on-disk app may behave differently — give it a try on `main` and see. If delete/merge undo doesn't restore on your machine either, the follow-up is to wire a manual `registerUndo(withTarget:handler:)` that snapshots the deleted contact and rebuilds it on undo.

## What's next on the list
With undo landed, the next picks I'd reach for from the menu I wrote up earlier:
- **B. Accessibility pass** — I can audit code; you'd verify with VoiceOver.
- **E. macOS Contacts framework bridge** — interop with the system Contacts.app (needs the Contacts permission entitlement).
- **F. App Intents + Spotlight indexing** — modern Mac integration; mostly Apple plumbing.

Want to pick one, or take a beat to use the app and see how undo feels first?

Merged — **#27** is on `main`, **54/54 tests** pass.

## What changed
- **One trailing toolbar group.** `ContactListView` now declares a single `ToolbarItemGroup(placement: .primaryAction)` with **Sort → New Contact → Inspector toggle**, so Liquid Glass renders one cohesive capsule instead of two scattered ones.
- **Trash button dropped.** `⌫` on a selected row still deletes via `.onDeleteCommand`.
- **`ContentView`** passes `$isInspectorVisible` into the list and drops its duplicate `ToolbarItem`.
- **Sidebar** always shows both *Contacts* and *Groups* sections — with a small *"Use the + button above to add one."* hint when no groups exist, so the column reads as deliberate on first launch.

Reopen the app on `main` and the trailing toolbar should now be one capsule on the right (with sort, +, and inspector), the search field on its own, and the sidebar will show both sections instead of just `All Contacts`.

If anything still reads as floating once you eyeball it (the search field is the only thing left outside that group — `.searchable` controls its placement), I can:
- pin the search next to the toolbar group with `searchable(text:placement:.toolbar, prompt:)` (worth trying if the search feels disconnected), or
- move the new-group button from the sidebar's toolbar into a section-header `+`, so the leading toolbar is just the sidebar toggle.

Tell me what still bugs you (or share another screenshot) and I'll iterate.

Got it — the window's minimum is `840`, but when the inspector opens you have 4 columns whose minimums add up to ~940 (sidebar 180 + list 240 + detail ~280 + inspector 240). So at small widths, opening the inspector squeezes the detail column to a sliver / breaks the layout.

Fix: make the window's minimum width depend on whether the inspector is visible.

{
  "file_path": "/Users/scottdensmore/Developer/scottdensmore/contactmanager/ContactManager/Views/LayoutMetrics.swift",
  "content": "//\n//  LayoutMetrics.swift\n//  ContactManager\n//\n//  Shared column-width constants for the three-/four-column layout. Keeping\n//  them in one place lets `ContentView` derive the window's minimum width\n//  from the same values the columns use, so tuning a column min can't drift\n//  the window min out of sync.\n//\n\nimport Foundation\n\nenum LayoutMetrics {\n    // Sidebar (groups).\n    static let sidebarMinWidth: CGFloat = 180\n    static let sidebarIdealWidth: CGFloat = 215\n    static let sidebarMaxWidth: CGFloat = 320\n\n    // Contact list.\n    static let listMinWidth: CGFloat = 240\n    static let listIdealWidth: CGFloat = 280\n    static let listMaxWidth: CGFloat = 420\n\n    // Detail column. Doesn't get an explicit column width (it takes the\n    // remaining space), but the form needs at least this much to look right;\n    // the window's minimum accounts for it.\n    static let detailMinWidth: CGFloat = 300\n\n    // Inspector.\n    static let inspectorMinWidth: CGFloat = 240\n    static let inspectorIdealWidth: CGFloat = 300\n    static let inspectorMaxWidth: CGFloat = 420\n\n    // Window minimum height.\n    static let windowMinHeight: CGFloat = 480\n\n    /// The window's minimum width for the current layout state.\n    static func windowMinWidth(isInspectorVisible: Bool) -> CGFloat {\n        let base = sidebarMinWidth + listMinWidth + detailMinWidth\n        return base + (isInspectorVisible ? inspectorMinWidth : 0)\n    }\n}\n"
}

> AGENT

Merged — **#28** is on `main`, **54/54 tests** pass.

## What changed
- **`LayoutMetrics`** — a new file holding the column min/ideal/max widths and a derived `windowMinWidth(isInspectorVisible:)`. Single source of truth.
- **`SidebarView`** and **`ContactListView`** use `LayoutMetrics.*Width` instead of hard-coded numbers.
- **`ContentView`** derives the window's `minWidth` from `LayoutMetrics`, including the inspector when it's visible. Tuning any column min later automatically keeps the window minimum in sync.
- **Effect:** when you toggle the inspector on a small window, macOS now expands it to a width that fits all four columns (sidebar + list + detail + inspector ≈ 960). When you toggle it off, the minimum shrinks back and you can drag the window smaller.

Try the same flow from your video — open the app small, click the trailing inspector toggle. The window should grow to fit the inspector cleanly instead of squeezing the detail column into nothing.

> AGENT

That's a stale Xcode state, not an actual build error. On `main` everything is in place:

- `ContactManager/Views/LayoutMetrics.swift` exists, is tracked in git, and is referenced in `project.pbxproj` (4 occurrences — file ref, group child, build file, sources phase).
- `xcodebuild` from the terminal builds cleanly (`BUILD SUCCEEDED`).

The `.swift` file got added to the project while Xcode had the project open, so Xcode's in-memory project state is out of date and its source editor is showing a stale "Cannot find" diagnostic.

**Fix on your end (one of these):**
1. **Easiest:** in Xcode, hit **⌘B** (Build). Xcode reloads `project.pbxproj` before building and the red diagnostic will disappear.
2. If ⌘B doesn't clear it: **Product → Clean Build Folder (⇧⌘K)**, then ⌘B.
3. If that *still* doesn't clear it: close the project (**⌘W** on the project window) and reopen it — Xcode re-reads `project.pbxproj` fresh.

To avoid this in future when you have the project open and I (or anything else) edits `project.pbxproj` externally, Xcode usually offers a "Project file was modified" prompt → **Revert** loads the disk version. If you accidentally dismiss that, ⌘B or reopen handles it.

Want me to add a tiny note to `CLAUDE.md` about this so it shows up the next time the project file is edited via the `xcodeproj` gem?

Merged — **#29** on `main`, **54/54 tests** pass.

## What I tried and what landed
- **Attempt 1:** `.searchToolbarBehavior(.minimize)` — the Tahoe Liquid Glass behavior that renders search as a magnifying-glass button that expands on click. The symbol exists in the SDK but is explicitly `@available(macOS, unavailable)` (iOS/iPadOS only). Build failed.
- **What landed:** `.searchable(placement: .toolbarPrincipal, prompt:)`. The field now anchors to the toolbar's center, so it sits between the trailing button group and the leading toolbar items instead of stretching across the inspector's column.

⌘B in Xcode (or ⌘R to run) and reopen the inspector — the search bar should sit centered in the toolbar and stop overlapping the Grace-Hopper avatar / inspector pane.

If the centered placement feels off to you (it's a real shift in where the field lives), the other clean fallback is a self-rolled `TextField` styled as a Tahoe glass capsule placed at the top of `ContactListView`'s body — fully scoped to the content column, immune to inspector overlap, but loses `⌘F`/`isSearching`/`dismissSearch` integration. Say the word and I'll switch to that.

> AGENT

You're right — these issues all stem from the inspector being a fourth column. A contact app with a 4-column NavigationSplitView is genuinely too crowded on macOS, and we've been chasing symptoms. My recommendation: **drop the inspector and fold its content (photo well, primary email/phone with copy, groups membership) back into the detail view as a header**. That gives you:

- One toolbar scoped to the contacts list (no overlap, no spanning)
- More horizontal space for the detail form
- "Contacts" title stays visible at any size
- No resize trickery — back to a clean 3-column layout (sidebar | list | detail)

Group membership\n\n    private func membership(in group: ContactGroup) -> Binding<Bool> {\n        Binding(\n            get: { contact.groups.contains { $0.persistentModelID == group.persistentModelID } },\n            set: { isMember in\n                do {\n                    try store.setMembership(of: contact, in: group, isMember: isMember)\n                } catch {\n                    errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n                }\n            }\n        )\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Photo actions\n\n    private func handleImport(_ result: Result<URL, Error>) {\n        switch result {\n        case .failure(let error):\n            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n        case .success(let url):\n            Task {\n                // Read the file and run the avatar pipeline off the main actor\n                // so a multi-megabyte photo can't hitch the UI.\n                let avatar: Data? = await Task.detached {\n                    let didAccess = url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()\n                    defer { if didAccess { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() } }\n                    guard let fileData = try? Data(contentsOf: url) else { return nil }\n                    return ImageProcessing.avatarData(from: fileData)\n                }.value\n\n                guard let avatar else {\n                    errorMessage = \"That file couldn't be read as an image.\"\n                    return\n                }\n                do {\n                    try store.setPhotoData(avatar, on: contact)\n                } catch {\n                    errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func removePhoto() {\n        do {\n            try store.setPhotoData(nil, on: contact)\n        } catch {\n            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Birthday bindings\n\n    private var birthdayEnabled: Binding<Bool> {\n        Binding(\n            get: { contact.birthday != nil },\n            set: { contact.birthday = $0 ? (contact.birthday ?? .now) : nil }\n        )\n    }\n\n    private var birthdayValue: Binding<Date> {\n        Binding(\n            get: { contact.birthday ?? .now },\n            set: { contact.birthday = $0 }\n        )\n    }\n}\n\n/// A single editable email/phone row: a label picker plus its value.\nprivate struct ContactFieldRow: View {\n    @Bindable var field: ContactField\n\n    var body: some View {\n        HStack {\n            Picker(\"\", selection: $field.label) {\n                ForEach(FieldLabel.allCases) { label in\n                    Text(label.title).tag(label)\n                }\n            }\n            .labelsHidden()\n            .fixedSize()\n\n            TextField(placeholder, text: $field.value)\n                .textContentType(field.kind == .email ? .emailAddress : .telephoneNumber)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private var placeholder: String {\n        field.kind == .email ? \"name@example.com\" : \"Phone\"\n    }\n}\n\nstruct ContactPlaceholderView: View {\n    var body: some View {\n        ContentUnavailableView(\n            \"No Contact Selected\",\n            systemImage: \"person.crop.circle\",\n            description: Text(\"Select a contact to view and edit their details.\")\n        )\n    }\n}\n"
}

159	    private func addContact() {
160	        do {
161	            // New contacts join the currently selected group, if any.
162	            let contact = try store.createContact(in: selectedGroup)
163	            withAnimation(.snappy) { selectedContact = contact }

171	        do {
172	            try store.delete(contact)
173	            if wasSelected { selectedContact = nil }
174	        } catch {
175	            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
176	        }
177	    }

182	        do {
183	            let group = try store.createGroup()
184	            withAnimation(.snappy) { sidebarSelection = .group(group.persistentModelID) }
185	        } catch {
186	            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
187	        }
188	    }
189	
190	    private func renameGroup(_ group: ContactGroup, to name: String) {
191	        do {
192	            try store.rename(group, to: name)
193	        } catch {
194	            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
195	        }
196	    }
197	
198	    private func deleteGroup(_ group: ContactGroup) {
199	        let wasSelected = sidebarSelection == .group(group.persistentModelID)
200	        do {
201	            try store.delete(group)
202	            if wasSelected { sidebarSelection = .allContacts }
203	        } catch {
204	            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
205	        }
206	    }
207	
208	    // MARK: - vCard import
209	
210	    private func handleImport(_ result: Result<URL, Error>) {
211	        switch result {
212	        case .failure(let error):
213	            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
214	        case .success(let url):
215	            Task {
216	                // Read and parse off the main actor so large files don't block UI.
217	                let parsed: [ParsedContact]? = await Task.detached {
218	                    let didAccess = url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()
219	                    defer { if didAccess { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() } }
220	                    guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),
221	                          let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else { return nil }
222	                    return VCard.parse(text)
223	                }.value
224	
225	                guard let parsed else {
226	                    errorMessage = "That file couldn't be read as a vCard."
227	                    return
228	                }
229	                guard !parsed.isEmpty else {
230	                    errorMessage = "No contacts were found in that file."
231	                    return
232	                }
233	                do {
234	                    try store.importContacts(parsed)
235	                } catch {
236	                    errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
237	                }
238	            }
239	        }
240	    }
241	}

Two issues to fix:

"text":"Merged — **#25** is on `main`, **47/47 tests** pass. That completes the original roadmap.\n\n## What landed\n- **Schema is CloudKit-compatible** — `Contact.fields = []` and inline defaults on every `ContactField` property (init API unchanged). No `.unique`, no `.deny` rules.\n- **`ContactManagerApp.loadContainer`** builds a `Schema` and tries `ModelConfiguration(cloudKitDatabase: .automatic)` first; on failure it falls back to `.none` so the app still runs without iCloud. `.automatic` also loads when no entitlement is present, so today's behavior is unchanged.\n- **Seeding is gated** to the confirmed local-only fallback (Copilot's catch), so a fresh second device can't seed samples that would race the initial sync and propagate.\n- `CLAUDE.md` documents the CloudKit-ready model conventions; `README.md` lists iCloud sync with the local-only fallback.\n\n## When you've got a device handy\n1. **Signing & Capabilities → + Capability → iCloud → CloudKit**, add a container (e.g. `iCloud.com.scottdensmore.ContactManager`).\n2. **+ Capability → Background Modes → Remote notifications** (so CloudKit can push updates).\n3. Build, run on a signed-in device. Add/edit a contact, then run on a second device — it should appear.\n\nIf something doesn't sync as expected, common gotchas: the iCloud container ID has to match the entitlement; user must be signed into iCloud on both devices; first launch can take a moment for the initial CloudKit setup. If anything looks off, share the Console output and I'll dig in.\n\n## Where the roadmap stands\nAll four of the post-rewrite features are now on `main`: **#22 dedup & merge**, **#23 vCard PHOTO round-trip**, **#24 detail inspector**, **#25 CloudKit-ready**. With #25 the original roadmap is fully complete.
